title: A Sectoral Comparison of ESG Disclosure: How Utilities and Tech Firms Leverage Social Media
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: A Sectoral Comparison of ESG Disclosure: How Utilities and Tech Firms Leverage Social Media

publicationDetails.detailsText: Articolo pubblicato sugli Annali 2024 del Dipartimento Jonico dell'Università degli Studi di Bari ANNO XII

detail.abstract: This study analyzed the dynamics of ESG communication strategies of companies in the utilities and in the technology sector, the motivations behind platform usage (Facebook and X) and sectoral priorities. The study confirms that utilities companies prioritize environmental and governance communication due to regulatory pressures, while technology companies focus on governance and social issues to build consumer trust.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了公用事业和科技行业公司ESG沟通策略的动态、平台使用动机（Facebook和X）以及行业优先事项，发现公用事业公司因监管压力优先关注环境与治理沟通，而科技公司则聚焦治理与社会议题以建立消费者信任。
AI.research_question: 公用事业和科技行业公司的ESG沟通策略有何动态差异？不同行业在社交媒体平台（Facebook和X）上的沟通动机和优先事项是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解不同行业企业如何在社交媒体上构建差异化的ESG沟通策略，以及驱动这些策略的行业特定因素（如监管压力与消费者信任）。
AI.theoretical_framework: ESG沟通理论、利益相关者理论、制度同构理论（监管压力与合法性机制）
AI.method: 比较分析方法，对公用事业与科技公司在Facebook和X平台上的ESG沟通内容进行分析，可能涉及内容编码或文本分析。
AI.findings: 公用事业公司因监管压力更侧重环境与治理沟通；科技公司为建立消费者信任更聚焦治理与社会议题。不同行业在社交媒体平台上的沟通优先级存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了行业特定因素（监管压力 vs. 消费者信任）如何塑造企业ESG沟通策略的差异化路径，丰富了制度理论与利益相关者理论在ESG沟通领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者制定社交媒体ESG沟通策略提供行业对标参考；为投资者和政策制定者理解不同行业ESG信息披露动机提供依据。

title: Three Barriers to Kantian Cooperation under Inequality
affiliations: and Higher Colleges of Technology

detail.title: Three Barriers to Kantian Cooperation under Inequality
detail.abstract: Multiplicative Kantian equilibrium, introduced by Roemer, has been proposed as a solution to inefficiency in social dilemmas, yet its emergence and stability are associated with a number of coordination and distributional difficulties. Drawing on a simple model of voluntary public good provision with two agents who differ in their initial endowments and have logarithmic preferences, this paper identifies three barriers that arise sequentially when unequal agents attempt to adopt Kantian cooperation voluntarily. The model builds on the classical setup of Bergstrom, Blume, and Varian and compares Nash equilibrium with multiplicative Kantian equilibrium under two different parametrizations: one in which the strategic variable is contributions to the public good, and another in which it is private consumption. First, we show that the transition from Nash equilibrium to contribution-space Kantian behavior is not always a Pareto improvement: under sufficiently high inequality, the poor agent may prefer the Nash outcome. This barrier can be mitigated by preliminary redistribution. Second, even when agents are willing to cooperate, the choice of a parametrization of the strategic space becomes a distributional issue: different ways of scaling actions lead to different distributive consequences and create a conflict of interest between agents. Third, if the chosen parametrization admits a continuum of Pareto-efficient outcomes, an additional coordination problem arises-agreeing on a specific point on the Pareto frontier. The paper reconstructs these barriers as a three-step coordination problem in which expectations about later stages affect agents' willingness to enter Kantian cooperation at the outset. On the basis of the results obtained, a program for further formal research is outlined. The findings contribute to understanding the conditions under which Kantian cooperation can be voluntarily adopted and sustainably maintained.

AI.tldr: 本文基于自愿公共品提供模型，分析了不平等主体在尝试采用乘法康德均衡时面临的三重障碍：帕累托改进缺失、策略空间参数化的分配冲突，以及帕累托前沿上的协调问题。研究表明，这些障碍构成了一个三阶段协调问题，早期阶段的预期会影响主体进入康德合作的意愿。
AI.research_question: 当不平等主体试图自愿采用康德合作时，面临哪些障碍？这些障碍如何影响康德均衡的涌现与稳定性？
AI.motivation: 乘法康德均衡被提出作为解决社会困境中无效率的方案，但其出现和稳定性与协调和分配困难相关。本文旨在系统识别并分析这些障碍，并探讨它们如何构成一个递进式的协调问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bergstrom, Blume和Varian的经典公共品提供模型，比较纳什均衡与乘法康德均衡。使用对数偏好，考虑两种参数化方式：以公共品贡献为策略变量，以及以私人消费为策略变量。
AI.method: 理论建模分析。构建两个初始禀赋不同的主体的自愿公共品提供模型，通过两种不同的参数化设定进行比较静态分析。
AI.findings: (1) 从纳什均衡到贡献空间康德行为的转移并非总是帕累托改进：高不平等下穷主体可能更偏好纳什结果；(2) 即使主体愿意合作，策略空间参数化的选择存在分配冲突；(3) 若参数化产生连续帕累托有效结果，则产生额外的协调问题；(4) 这些障碍构成三阶段协调问题，前期预期影响后期参与意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统识别并形式化了不平等主体自愿采纳康德合作的三重递进式障碍；揭示了策略空间参数化选择的分配含义；将预期因素纳入康德合作的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 阐明康德合作自愿采纳的条件限制，为公共品提供中的合作机制设计提供理论指导；指出初步再分配可能缓解第一重障碍，为政策干预提供启示。

title: When Signals Go Silent: A Regime-switching Theory of Dividend Policy under Systemic Uncertainty
affiliations: Ecole Superieure des Sciences Economiques et Commerciales de Tunis (ESSECT),  Université de Tunis

detail.title: When Signals Go Silent: A Regime-switching Theory of Dividend Policy under Systemic Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Despite six decades of research, the "dividend puzzle" (Black, 1976) remains unresolved because competing explanations, signaling, agency/free cash flow, clientele, life cycle, and catering theories, are typically treated as mutually exclusive and time-invariant. This paper develops the Informational-to-Disciplinary Switching (IDS) framework, a regime-contingent theory proposing that the dominant mechanism governing corporate payout decisions shifts with the level of systemic uncertainty. Under normal conditions, dividends primarily function as costly signals of managers' private information about future earnings (the informational regime). Under heightened systemic uncertainty, financial crises, pandemics, sovereign-debt shocks, aggregate noise erodes the cross-sectional informativeness of dividend signals, and the dominant function of payout shifts toward disciplining managerial discretion over scarce free cash flow, with ownership structure and corporate governance becoming the primary determinants (the disciplinary regime). We formalize this intuition with a deliberately light analytical model featuring a systemic-uncertainty parameter and an endogenous switching threshold, derive six testable propositions, and outline an empirical research design, combining event-study and panel-threshold methods, suited to emerging-market settings where governance heterogeneity and crisis exposure are pronounced. The framework reconciles fragmented strands of the dividend literature within a single dynamic architecture and yields direct implications for investors, boards, and regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息-惩戒切换（IDS）框架，认为企业股利发放的主导机制会随系统性不确定性水平变化：正常时期股利主要作为管理层私有信息的信号（信息机制），而在高度不确定性时期（如金融危机、疫情），信号被噪声淹没，股利转向惩戒管理层对稀缺自由现金流的滥用（惩戒机制）。基于一个轻量分析模型推导出六个可检验命题，并设计了适用于新兴市场的实证方案。
AI.research_question: 股利之谜中相互竞争的解释（信号、代理/自由现金流、客户群、生命周期、迎合理论）是否可能在不同系统性不确定性水平下交替主导，而非彼此排斥或一成不变？
AI.motivation: 六十年来股利之谜未解，现有理论通常被视为互斥且时间不变。作者试图构建一个动态的统一框架，解释为何不同理论在不同时期都能找到实证支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息-惩戒切换（IDS）框架；系统性不确定性参数与内生切换阈值；信号传递理论（正常时期）与代理理论/自由现金流理论（高不确定性时期）
AI.method: 轻量分析模型（含系统性不确定性参数和内生切换阈值）；推导六个可检验命题；提出结合事件研究和面板门槛方法的实证设计（适用于新兴市场）
AI.findings: 正常时期股利主要传递未来盈利信息（信息机制）；高系统性不确定性时期（危机、疫情、主权债务冲击），股利信号的信息含量被聚合噪声侵蚀，股利的主要功能转向约束管理层对稀缺自由现金流的处置（惩戒机制），此时所有权结构和公司治理成为主要决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将相互竞争的股利理论整合在一个动态体系中，提出制度/状态依存（regime-contingent）的解释机制，而非认为某一理论普遍适用。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者（如何在不同宏观环境下解读股利信号）、董事会（何时调整股利政策目标）和监管者（危机期间是否干预分红政策）有直接启示。

title: The Meritorious 'Other': The Interconnection of Merit and Race in EU Migration and Asylum Law
affiliations: , Stockholm School of Economics, Central European University (CEU) and Warsaw School of Economics (SGH)

detail.title: The Meritorious 'Other': The Interconnection of Merit and Race in EU Migration and Asylum Law
detail.abstract: Adopting a law-in-context approach, this article suggests that merit-based migrant selection in the European Union (EU) is implicitly shaped by racial dynamics. With a focus on EU law and more specifically on cases from the Netherlands and Germany, it argues that the growing emphasis on merit enables a limited number of 'racialised others' to counterbalance the structural disadvantages associated with their citizenships, whilst simultaneously legitimising the exclusion of those considered insufficiently meritorious within the same group. By bridging two distinct strands of scholarship-critical analyses of the racial dimensions of migration policy and studies of merit-based selection mechanisms-this article advances existing debates on EU migration and asylum governance. It posits that the normative appeal of merit acts to justify existing hierarchies and to obscure the underlying racialisation processes that sustain them.

AI.tldr: 本文采用"法律在情境中"的研究路径，论证欧盟基于功绩的移民选择制度实际上隐含了种族化逻辑。通过聚焦欧盟法及荷兰、德国的案例，文章指出"功绩"话语既让少数"种族化他者"有机会抵消其国籍带来的结构性劣势，又将同一群体中"功绩不足者"合法地排除在外。文章弥合了移民政策种族维度的批判研究与功绩选拔机制研究两派学术脉络，推进了欧盟移民与庇护治理的现有辩论，认为功绩的规范性吸引力恰恰起到了遮蔽种族化过程、正当化既有等级秩序的作用。
AI.research_question: 欧盟基于功绩的移民选择制度如何隐性地受到种族动态的塑造？功绩话语在欧盟移民治理中发挥怎样的合法化与遮蔽功能？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将功绩选拔机制视为中立的技术工具，忽视了其内在的种族化逻辑。作者旨在揭示"功绩"这一看似中性的标准如何与种族化过程交织，并解释为何功绩话语能在欧盟移民治理中获得如此广泛的规范性认同。
AI.theoretical_framework: "法律在情境中"（law-in-context）研究路径；批判种族理论视角下的移民政策分析；功绩选拔机制研究（merit-based selection mechanisms）。
AI.method: 法律分析结合案例研究，聚焦欧盟法框架以及荷兰、德国的具体实践，采用定性比较与批判话语分析相结合的方法。
AI.findings: （1）功绩标准允许少数"种族化他者"突破国籍带来的结构性劣势实现合法迁移；（2）但同时，功绩话语将同一群体中"功绩不足者"合法排除在外；（3）功绩的规范性吸引力使得种族化过程被遮蔽，既有等级秩序被自然化与正当化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将批判种族理论与功绩选拔机制研究进行跨领域对话，揭示了欧盟移民治理中"功绩"隐含的种族化逻辑，推进了对欧盟移民与庇护治理合法化机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及成员国移民政策制定者提供批判性反思视角，提示政策制定需警惕"功绩"话语可能掩盖的结构性种族不平等，促进更具包容性的移民治理实践。

title:
Contractual Subordination and Restitution after Breach 
Quantum Meruit for the Defaulting Performer in New York Law
affiliations: Columbia Law School

detail.title:
Contractual Subordination and Restitution after Breach 
Quantum Meruit for the Defaulting Performer in New York Law
detail.abstract: The hardest restitution problem in contract law is not whether breach is wrongful. It is whether the recipient of partial performance has a legal basis for retaining the net benefit of that performance without paying for it. New York law intensifies that problem. On one side, Clark-Fitzpatrick and Corsello make clear that quasi-contract is unavailable where a valid and enforceable contract governs the subject matter and that unjust enrichment is not a fallback whenever ordinary claims fail. On the other side, Farash, Bradkin, substantial-performance doctrine, and UCC § 2-718 reflect an anti-windfall impulse that sometimes allows recovery for requested or retained benefits without enforcing the claimant’s failed contractual theory. New York has not adopted Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 374 as a general rule for breaching performers across contract categories. This article therefore replaces the moral question—should the breacher recover?—with a legal question: does contract, statute, equity, or offset legally justify the recipient’s retention of the net benefit? It argues that New York breaching-party restitution is best understood through contractual subordination. Restitution to a defaulting performer is not categorically barred because the claimant breached, but it is also not freely available whenever the recipient benefited. It is available, if at all, only when subordinate to the parties’ enforceable contract, statutory policy, equitable limitations, and compensatory offsets. The framework has immediate commercial significance. Businesses that want predictable consequences after partial performance, termination, abandonment, or breach must draft expressly for accepted work, payment triggers, offsets, liquidated damages, intellectual-property ownership, and quasi-contract waiver.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论纽约州合同法中关于违约方返还请求权的"合同从属"理论框架：违约方不是绝对不能获得返还，但只有在从属于有效合同、成文法政策、衡平法限制和补偿性抵销的前提下才可能获得。
AI.research_question: 在纽约州法律中，违约方就其部分履行所赋予对方的净利益，在何种法律基础上有权获得返还（而非被对方无偿保留）？
AI.motivation: 纽约州判例法在违约方返还问题上存在矛盾：一方（Clark-Fitzpatrick, Corsello）禁止在有合同存在时适用准合同/不当得利救济；另一方（Farash, Bradkin等）又体现反意外之财原则，允许在部分履行情形下获得返还。纽约州也未采纳《合同法重述（二）》第374条。这一法律不确定性对商业实践构成重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出"合同从属"（contractual subordination）理论：违约方的返还请求权并非因违约而被绝对禁止，也不是只要对方受益就可自由获得，而必须"从属于"双方有效合同的约定、成文法政策、衡平法限制以及补偿性抵销。
AI.method: 判例法分析：系统梳理纽约州相关判例（Clark-Fitzpatrick, Corsello, Farash, Bradkin等）及成文法（UCC § 2-718），并与《合同法重述（二）》第374条进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 纽约州违约方返还规则的实质是"合同从属"：（1）不是道德判断（违约者是否应得）而是法律判断（对方保留利益是否有法律依据）；（2）有合同存在时返还并非当然不可获得，但须从属于合同条款；（3）衡平法限制和补偿性抵销进一步限制返还范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 将纽约州看似矛盾的判例法整合为统一的"合同从属"理论框架，替代传统的道德性分析进路，为理解违约方返还请求权提供了更精确的法律分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业实践提供明确指导：企业若希望在部分履行、终止、违约后获得可预测的法律后果，必须在合同中明确约定：已接受工作的处理、付款触发条件、抵销条款、违约金、知识产权归属及准合同弃权条款。

title: Quantifying Systemic Topological Fragility: A Geometric Framework for Stress Testing Algorithmic Consensus in Multi-asset Markets

detail.title: Quantifying Systemic Topological Fragility: A Geometric Framework for Stress Testing Algorithmic Consensus in Multi-asset Markets
detail.abstract: The accelerating consolidation of quantitative investment strategies around a narrow set of machine learning architectures and alternative data sources has created a latent class of systemic risk that conventional stochastic risk models are mathematically incapable of detecting. This paper formalises the phenomenon of Algorithmic Consensus Homogenisation (ACH), defined as the convergence of independent trading agents onto statistically equivalent epistemic manifolds, and investigates its consequences for market stability and liquidity resilience. We develop a geometric programme, Topological Finance, that embeds highfrequency limit order book (LOB) data as a multi-dimensional point cloud and monitors the temporal evolution of persistent topological invariants, Fisher information metric contraction, and Ollivier-Ricci curvature to detect structural fragility before it propagates into observable prices. The central theoretical claim is that market crashes are not exogenous surprises but are deterministic Ricci singularities: geometric phase transitions in which the curvature of the market manifold concentrates to a structural breaking point. We validate a 220-tick lead-time advantage over conventional volatility triggers and propose Geometric Circuit Breakers as a regulatory instrument triggered by structural metric decay rather than lagging price movement. The framework delivers actionable contributions to institutional risk management, financial regulation, and the foundations of market efficiency theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"算法共识同质化"（ACH）概念，指独立交易策略收敛到统计等效的认知流形上，形成传统模型无法检测的隐性系统性风险。作者建立"拓扑金融"框架，利用持久拓扑不变量、Fisher信息度量收缩和Ollivier-Ricci曲率监测市场流形的结构脆弱性，主张市场崩盘是确定性的Ricci奇点（几何相变），并在实证中比传统波动率触发器提前220个tick发出预警。
AI.research_question: 量化投资策略趋同如何形成传统风险模型无法检测的隐性系统性风险？能否通过拓扑和几何方法提前识别市场崩盘的结构性前兆？
AI.motivation: 传统随机风险模型在数学上无法检测因策略同质化导致的系统性风险积累，需要新的理论框架来识别价格尚无明显反应时的市场结构脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Algorithmic Consensus Homogenisation (ACH)；Topological Finance（拓扑金融）；Ricci奇点理论（市场崩盘作为几何相变）；持久拓扑不变量、Fisher信息度量收缩、Ollivier-Ricci曲率。
AI.method: 将高频限价订单簿（LOB）数据嵌入为多维点云，追踪其拓扑不变量和几何曲率的时间演化，通过流形结构的度量衰减来检测系统性脆弱性。
AI.findings: 市场崩盘不是外生冲击，而是市场流形曲率集中到结构断裂点的确定性几何相变；该框架可比传统波动率触发器提前220个tick发出预警信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"算法共识同质化"（ACH）概念；将市场崩溃重新定义为Ricci奇点（几何相变）；建立拓扑金融作为市场微观结构分析的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"几何熔断机制"（Geometric Circuit Breakers），以结构度量衰减而非滞后的价格变动为触发条件；为机构风险管理和金融监管提供可操作的预警工具。

title: The Welfare Cost of Knowing: Social Comparison of Choice Opportunities

detail.title: The Welfare Cost of Knowing: Social Comparison of Choice Opportunities
detail.abstract: Does learning that others have superior choice opportunities reduce welfare when one's own options remain unchanged? Using an incentivized experiment with 448 participants, I randomly assign participants to identical small choice sets while varying only information about others' access to larger sets. Participants informed about differential access experience substantial welfare effects: satisfaction decreases by 0.284 points (p = 0.058), choice stability falls by 28.5 percentage points (p < 0.001), and willingness to retain chosen items drops by 16.9 percentage points (p = 0.017). These opportunity-based social comparison effects-representing a distinct welfare channel-completely offset the welfare gains from actual choice expansion. The results imply that when differences in access become visible, transparency itself can impose utility losses comparable to the gains from expanded options. This reveals a fundamental tension between information disclosure and individual welfare in digitally mediated markets.

AI.tldr: 他人拥有更优选择机会的信息会降低福利，即使自己的选择集不变。实验发现机会不平等导致的福利损失完全抵消了选择扩张带来的收益。
AI.research_question: 当自己的选择集不变时，得知他人拥有更优选择机会是否会降低个体福利？
AI.motivation: 在数字化市场中，信息透明度日益提高，消费者容易观察到他人拥有的不同选择机会。这种社会比较是否会损害福利，值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机会型社会比较理论；福利经济学中关于选择集与效用关系的理论。
AI.method: 激励性实验，448名参与者被随机分配到相同的小选择集，仅改变关于他人拥有更大选择集的信息。
AI.findings: (1) 满意度降低0.284分(p=0.058)；(2) 选择稳定性下降28.5个百分点(p<0.001)；(3) 保留所选物品意愿下降16.9个百分点(p=0.017)。这些效应完全抵消了实际选择扩张带来的福利增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别出"机会型社会比较效应"作为一个独立的福利影响渠道；揭示了信息透明度与个体福利之间的根本张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字化市场的平台设计提供警示：信息透明度可能带来意想不到的福利成本；政策制定者需考虑信息披露的福利影响。

title: Two Faced: A Wellness-informed Framework for Therapeutic Beauty Practice | Presence, Nonverbal Intelligence, and the Ministry of the Chair

detail.title: Two Faced: A Wellness-informed Framework for Therapeutic Beauty Practice | Presence, Nonverbal Intelligence, and the Ministry of the Chair
detail.abstract: This paper introduces Two Faced, a wellness-informed framework for therapeutic beauty practice developed by R. Nicole Smith, a licensed minister and credentialed Marriage and Family Therapist. Two Faced reframes the beauty chair as a site of intentional interruption-a space where clients are invited to step out of autopilot, be witnessed in their full complexity, and experience practitioner presence that is clinically informed without constituting clinical treatment. Drawing on graduate training in trauma-informed care, nonverbal communication, family systems theory, and human development, the framework proposes that beauty practitioners equipped with therapeutic literacy can function as meaningful points of contact in a client's healing ecology-not as therapists, but as witnesses. The paper explores the cultural and theological dimensions of the "two faces" women carry, articulates the clinical competencies that inform Two Faced practice, establishes a protective language system that maintains scope of practice integrity, and positions wellness-informed beauty work as a legitimate interdisciplinary contribution at the intersection of practical theology, somatic awareness, and community care.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"双面"（Two Faced）框架，一种基于健康理念的治疗性美容实践体系，将美容椅重塑为有意干预的空间，使美容从业者具备治疗素养后，能够作为客户康复生态中的见证者而非治疗师发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 如何将临床治疗素养融入美容实践，使美容从业者在不越界成为治疗师的前提下，为客户提供具有治疗意义的见证与陪伴？
AI.motivation: 女性在日常生活中承载着"双重面孔"——外在的社会角色与内在的真实自我，美容空间作为女性频繁接触的场所，具有被重新定义为治疗性干预节点的潜力，但缺乏系统的理论框架来规范这一实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创伤知情护理、非言语沟通理论、家庭系统理论、人类发展理论、实践神学、躯体觉知理论、社区关怀理论。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念化研究，基于作者作为持证婚姻与家庭治疗师及执业牧师的跨学科训练，提出整合性实践框架。
AI.findings: 提出了"美容椅作为有意干预空间"的概念；建立了维持执业范围完整性的保护性语言系统；将健康导向的美容工作定位为实践神学、躯体觉知与社区关怀交叉领域的合法跨学科贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将临床治疗素养与美容实践相结合，提出了"见证者"而非"治疗师"的角色区分；在实践神学与美容实践之间建立了理论桥梁；拓展了社区关怀与非正式照护网络的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美容从业者提供了可操作的治疗性沟通与见证框架；建立了保护性语言系统以避免职业越界；为社会工作者和治疗师提供了与社区非正式照护者合作的参考模型。

title: Firms' Partisan Alignment and Economic Expectations

detail.title: Firms' Partisan Alignment and Economic Expectations
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether firms' partisan alignment with the incumbent president shapes their economic optimism, and whether such alignment-driven optimism translates into firms' stated business plans. I measure firms' partisan preferences by aggregating executives' political donation behavior using the DIME database. I then define partisan alignment based on whether a firm's partisan preference matches that of the sitting president. Using firmlevel survey data from the Duke CFO Survey, I estimate panel regressions with firm and year fixed effects to exploit within-firm variation in partisan alignment over time. I find that partisan alignment significantly boosts firms' optimism about both the aggregate economy and their own financial prospects, while partisan preference alone has no predictive power absent alignment. However, this alignment-driven optimism does not appear to carry over into firms' stated business plans, even though general optimism itself is shown to be a significant predictor of stated plans in the data. These patterns are suggestive of a parallel to the householdlevel cheerleading effect documented by Mian, Sufi and Khoshkhou (2023). The findings extend the literature on partisan bias in economic expectations from households to firms, suggesting that similar mechanisms may operate at the firm level.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业党派倾向是否影响其经济乐观度，以及这种乐观是否会转化为商业计划。研究发现，当企业的党派偏好与在任总统一致时，其经济乐观度显著提升，但这种乐观并未传导至企业实际商业计划中，存在类似家庭层面的"喝彩效应"。
AI.research_question: 企业的党派倾向是否影响其经济乐观度？这种由党派一致驱动的乐观是否会转化为企业声明的商业计划？
AI.motivation: 已有文献发现家庭层面的党派偏见会影响经济预期（如Mian, Sufi and Khoshkhou, 2023的"喝彩效应"），但企业层面是否也存在类似机制尚不明确。企业的经济预期对实体经济活动有重要影响，理解党派因素如何塑造企业预期具有重要的学术和政策意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 党派偏见理论、党派一致性与经济预期的关系、"喝彩效应"（cheerleading effect）。
AI.method: 利用DIME数据库汇总企业高管的政治捐款行为来衡量企业党派偏好；基于企业党派偏好与在任总统是否一致定义党派一致性；使用杜克CFO调查的企业层面面板数据，采用包含企业固定效应和年份固定效应的面板回归模型，利用企业内部党派一致性随时间变化来识别因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）党派一致性能显著提升企业对整体经济及自身财务前景的乐观度，而单纯的党派偏好本身（在缺乏一致性时）没有预测能力；（2）然而，这种由党派一致性驱动的乐观并未传导至企业声明的商业计划；（3）一般性的乐观度本身就是企业商业计划的重要预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将党派偏见对经济预期的影响研究从家庭层面拓展到企业层面，证明类似"喝彩效应"的机制在企业层面同样存在，丰富了政治经济学与公司金融交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和市场参与者在解读企业经济预期调查数据时，需考虑党派一致性因素可能带来的系统性偏差；同时表明企业高管的党派乐观与实际决策之间存在脱节，有助于更准确地理解企业预期-行为关系。

title:
The Abstraction Path of the Labor Theory of Value: Variable Demotion, the Multiple Realizability of the
Determinant, and the Reality Constraint Principle
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The Abstraction Path of the Labor Theory of Value: Variable Demotion, the Multiple Realizability of the
Determinant, and the Reality Constraint Principle
detail.abstract: The labor theory of value (LTV) builds a highly unied framework of value determination around socially necessary labor time (SNLT) as its core explanatory variable. Yet at the nal explanatory level, real productive variablescapital, technology, institutions, organization, and material conditionsare systematically reduced to derivative forms of labor, yielding a singlecause, vertically reductive abstraction path. This paper proposes a Reality Constraint Principle and situates it within the philosophy-of-science traditions of Popper, Lakatos, and Kuhn. On this basis it advances a limited but pointed methodological argument: with respect to the function of explaining price coordination, the determinant of value is multiply realizable any real factor that directly participates in production can occupy the formal position of LTV's unique source of valueand demonstrates this through a minimal, computable construction. It follows that labor's special status is a theoretical stipulation rather than a theoretical necessity. The paper further proposes a Realistic Production Cross-Section Model as a methodological contrast tool, showing the form a framework takes when abstraction preserves the independent standing of the main real variables. The aim is methodological critique, not the construction of a substitute theory of value; the conclusions are strictly conned to the testability of the abstraction path and pass no verdict on the proposition of surplus value or exploitation as such.

AI.tldr: 本文批判劳动价值论（LTV）将一切生产变量简化为劳动的单一归因抽象路径，提出"现实约束原则"，论证价值决定因素具有多重可实现性，并通过最小可计算构造证明劳动的特殊地位是理论规定而非理论必然。文章进一步提出"现实生产截面模型"作为方法论对比工具，但仅限于方法论批判，不涉及对剩余价值或剥削命题本身的评判。
AI.research_question: 劳动价值论中劳动作为唯一价值决定因素的理论地位是逻辑必然还是理论规定？价值决定因素是否具有多重可实现性？
AI.motivation: 劳动价值论（LTV）在解释价格协调功能时，将资本、技术、制度、组织、物质条件等真实生产变量系统性地还原为劳动的派生形式，形成了一种单因垂直还原的抽象路径。这种还原是否具有理论上的必然性，值得方法论层面的深入审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现实约束原则（Reality Constraint Principle）；波普尔、拉卡托斯、库恩的科学哲学传统；多重可实现性（multiple realizability）论点；劳动价值论的抽象路径批判。
AI.method: 方法论论证与最小可计算构造（minimal computable construction），通过形式化论证展示价值决定因素的多重可实现性；提出"现实生产截面模型"（Realistic Production Cross-Section Model）作为方法论对比工具。
AI.findings: 决定价格协调的价值因素具有多重可实现性——任何直接参与生产的真实因素都可以占据LTV中劳动作为唯一价值来源的形式位置；劳动的特殊地位是理论规定（theoretical stipulation）而非理论必然（theoretical necessity）。
AI.theory_contributions: 从方法论和科学哲学层面揭示了劳动价值论抽象路径的可检验性问题，提出了"现实约束原则"作为评估理论抽象合理性的标准，挑战了LTV中劳动唯一决定地位的理论正当性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学理论建构的方法论反思提供了新视角，有助于避免单一归因的理论封闭，推动更贴近现实生产条件的理论框架构建；但作者明确限定本文不提供替代性的价值理论。

title: Lived-experiences and Demand for Redistribution: Evidence from Exposure to Long-run Natural Hazards
affiliations: Florida Atlantic University

detail.title: Lived-experiences and Demand for Redistribution: Evidence from Exposure to Long-run Natural Hazards

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: How do uncontrollable shocks affect preferences for redistribution? This paper examines whether long-run exposure to natural hazards shifts distributive preferences toward greater support for income equality and away from stronger incentives for individual effort. I link individual-level data from the joint European Values Study and World Values Survey to country-level measures of exposure to droughts, floods, and extreme temperatures. The analysis covers 80,701 respondents nested within 737 local regions and 56 countries/territories. Using multilevel hierarchical models, and confirming the results with OLS and ordered logit specifications, I find that greater hazard exposure is associated with significantly stronger support for making incomes more equal and weaker support for effort-based distributive preferences. Interaction analyses show that this association is strongest among respondents who initially place greater weight on hard work, among higher-income groups, and in countries characterized by stronger institutional quality and higher preexisting inequality. These patterns are consistent with political-economy accounts in which exogenous shocks alter beliefs about fairness, increase perceived vulnerability, and strengthen demand for collective insurance and compensation. The findings contribute to the political economy of redistribution by showing that distributive preferences are shaped not only by income, ideology, and mobility expectations, but also by lived exposure to uncontrollable risk.

AI.tldr: 本文利用跨国多层数据（80,701名受访者，覆盖56个国家/地区），发现长期暴露于自然灾害（干旱、洪水、极端温度）会显著增强人们对收入平等的支持，同时削弱对基于个人努力的分配偏好的支持。这种效应在更看重努力工作、高收入群体以及制度质量高、不平等程度高的国家中尤为显著。
AI.research_question: 不可控的冲击（自然灾害）如何影响人们的再分配偏好？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注收入、意识形态和流动性预期对再分配偏好的影响，但较少探讨外部不可控风险（如自然灾害）的长期暴露如何塑造人们的分配正义观念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学框架：外生冲击会改变人们对公平的信念，增加感知到的脆弱性，并强化对集体保险和补偿的需求。
AI.method: 使用欧洲价值观调查和世界价值观调查的个体层面数据，结合国家层面的干旱、洪水、极端温度暴露指标，采用多层分层模型（multilevel hierarchical models），并以OLS和有序Logit模型进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1）自然灾害暴露程度越高，人们越支持收入平等，越不支持基于努力的分配偏好；2）这种关联在更看重努力工作的人、高收入群体、以及制度质量高和原有不平等程度高的国家中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了再分配政治经济学的理论边界，证明除收入、意识形态和流动预期外，生活经历中的不可控风险暴露也是塑造分配偏好的重要因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解自然灾害频发地区公众对再分配政策的支持提供了实证依据，提示政策制定者在灾害应对中需关注民众公平观念的变迁。

title: High-Entropy Intelligence: From Materials to Markets to Minds toward AGI
affiliations: , ,  and National Chung Hsing University

detail.title: High-Entropy Intelligence: From Materials to Markets to Minds toward AGI
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces Behavioral Consensus Theory (BCT) as a new solution to the longstanding
problem of financial market complexity. BCT is grounded in High-Entropy Intelligence (HEI)
principles and directly addresses Ashby's Law of Requisite Variety, which states that only
variety can absorb variety—meaning controllers must possess internal complexity matching the
systems they regulate. Financial markets, as high-entropy emergent systems, have historically
evaded low-entropy models precisely because those models violate Ashby's Law by lacking
sufficient configurational diversity. BCT is conceptually inspired by high-entropy alloying (HEA)
in materials science, where heterogeneous components achieve superior emergent properties
through entropic integration and entanglement.
BCT proposes three synergistic consensus mechanisms that jointly govern price formation in
complex markets: (1) Psychological Causality Consensus Effect—prices arise from a quantitative
equilibrium shaped by rational and irrational forces, incorporating memory, anchoring, attention,
and other behavioral constraints. (2) Physical Equivalence Consensus Effect—market dynamics
follow quantum-mechanical analogues, including price orbitals, tunneling behaviors, state
transitions, and symmetry-preserving and symmetry-breaking mechanisms. (3) Spatiotemporal
Entanglement Consensus Effect—price dynamic prediction accuracy is enhanced by determining
the best representative reduced entanglement derived from prior consensuses' treatment across
multiple temporal, structural, and spatial layers of market information.
By satisfying Ashby's Law through high configurational diversity across behavioral, physical, and
spatiotemporal dimensions, BCT achieves the requisite variety necessary to match market
complexity. Using rigorous mathematical formalization and empirical tests on PEAD, we demonstrate that these consensus effects jointly resolve persistent anomalies such as congestion,
trending, jump discontinuities, volatility clustering, and Post-Earnings Announcement Drift
(PEAD). The framework establishes Psychoeconophysics as a transdisciplinary field unifying
behavioral finance with modern physics and provides a foundational architecture for Artificial
Finance Intelligence (AFI) systems. Most critically, BCT delivers the first unified quantitative
model that integrates rational and irrational decision processes within a single coherent system—
resolving the century-long divide between rational expectations theory and behavioral finance.
Our findings suggest that High-Entropy frameworks can offer superior modeling power for
complex adaptive systems well beyond financial markets, with implications for artificial general
intelligence and multi-scale systems science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行为共识理论（BCT），借鉴材料科学中的高熵合金概念，通过心理因果共识、物理等效共识和时空纠缠共识三种机制，统一理性预期与行为金融学，解决金融市场复杂性问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够满足阿什比必要多样性定律、统一理性与非理性决策过程的高熵金融模型，以解释和预测复杂金融市场的价格形成与异象？
AI.motivation: 传统低熵金融模型因违反阿什比定律而无法充分匹配金融市场的复杂性，理性预期理论与行为金融学之间长期存在分裂，需要一种高熵框架来整合二者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为共识理论（BCT）、高熵智能（HEI）原理、阿什比必要多样性定律、高熵合金化（HEA）类比、心理因果共识效应、物理等效共识效应（量子力学类比）、时空纠缠共识效应
AI.method: 理论建构与数学形式化推导，结合PEAD（盈余公告后漂移）的实证检验。
AI.findings: BCT的三个共识机制联合解决了拥堵、趋势、跳跃不连续性、波动率聚集和PEAD等持续性异象；首次在统一量化模型中整合了理性与非理性决策过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出行为共识理论作为统一框架，弥合理想预期理论与行为金融学之间的百年分歧；建立心理经济学（Psychoeconophysics）这一跨学科领域；将高熵框架拓展至复杂适应系统与通用人工智能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人工智能金融智能（AFI）系统提供基础架构；为金融市场异象提供可检验的量化解决方案。

title: The Truman Theory: A Formal Synthesis of Cosmic Quarantine, Simulation, and Managed-civilization Hypotheses
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Truman Theory: A Formal Synthesis of Cosmic Quarantine, Simulation, and Managed-civilization Hypotheses
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Truman Theory, a formal synthesis of three frameworks that are usually treated
separately: John Ball's zoo hypothesis, Nick Bostrom's simulation argument, and the cultural model supplied by
The Truman Show. The central claim is not that any single UAP report proves extraterrestrial management, nor
that human history can be reduced to a controlled experiment. The claim is narrower and more rigorous. Given
the age of the universe, the abundance of planets, the likely existence of civilizations far older than ours, the
recurrent emergence of power structures in complex adaptive systems, and the reported concentration of
anomalous aerospace phenomena around nuclear and strategic sites, Earth may be best modeled as a protected,
observed, and occasionally managed primitive civilization. The model treats direct public contact as a boundary
condition rather than an oversight. It also treats secrecy less as a human conspiracy than as an epistemic feature
of managed non-interference: once the subject civilization knows the full context of observation, the object of
study changes. The paper distinguishes established science, logical extrapolation, and speculative inference,
then develops the Truman Theory as a hypothesis with philosophical, astrobiological, political, and existential-
risk implications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"楚门理论"（Truman Theory），综合了约翰·鲍尔的动物园假说、尼克·博斯特罗姆的模拟论证以及《楚门的世界》中的文化模型，认为地球可能是一个被保护、观察并偶尔管理的原始文明。该理论不依赖任何单一UAP报告，而是基于宇宙年龄、行星丰度、远古文明存在的可能性、权力结构在复杂适应系统中的涌现，以及异常航天现象在核战略设施周围的集中报告。
AI.research_question: 地球是否可以被最佳地建模为一个被更高级文明保护、观察并偶尔管理的原始文明？这种管理模式对直接公开接触、保密机制以及人类文明发展有何哲学和存在风险层面的含义？
AI.motivation: 作者试图将三个通常被分开处理的框架——动物园假说、模拟论证和《楚门的世界》文化模型——进行正式综合，以解释UAP（不明异常现象）在敏感军事设施周围集中出现的现象，并探讨人类文明可能处于"被管理非干涉"状态这一假设的学术意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 约翰·鲍尔的动物园假说（Zoo Hypothesis）；2. 尼克·博斯特罗姆的模拟论证（Simulation Argument）；3. 《楚门的世界》提供的文化模型。三者被形式化地综合为"楚门理论"。
AI.method: 理论综合与逻辑推演：将三个既有框架进行形式化综合，区分"已确立的科学"、"逻辑外推"和"推测性推理"三个层次，然后推导该理论的哲学、天体生物学、政治和存在风险层面的含义。
AI.findings: 1. 直接公开接触（"出柜"）被视为边界条件而非疏忽；2. 保密不是人类的阴谋，而是"被管理非干涉"的认知特征——一旦被观察的文明知道完整的观测背景，研究对象就会改变；3. 人类历史可以被建模为受控实验，但不等于将其还原为受控实验。
AI.theory_contributions: 将三个原本独立的框架（动物园假说、模拟论证、文化模型）首次进行形式化综合，提出"被管理非干涉"和"公开接触作为边界条件"等新概念，为UAP研究提供了超越阴谋论框架的认知论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解UAP集中于核战略设施的现象提供了新的解释框架；对国家安全和保密政策提供了认知论的重新解读；为存在风险研究和天体生物学提供了可供检验的假设结构。

title: External Accountability and Fiscal Transparency in Hierarchical Governance: Evidence from Chinese Cities
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Peking University and Development Research Center of the State Council

detail.title: External Accountability and Fiscal Transparency in Hierarchical Governance: Evidence from Chinese Cities
detail.abstract: Fiscal transparency is a cornerstone of public governance, yet its determinants remain contested. This article argues that fiscal transparency is primarily driven by external accountability-market discipline and administrative hierarchy-rather than societal demand or local leaders' initiative, especially in systems lacking electoral accountability. Using an original dataset of fiscal disclosures from 294 Chinese cities (2013-2021), we construct a comprehensive fiscal transparency index covering institutional, on-budget, and off-budget dimensions. The analysis shows that market exposure and hierarchical oversight significantly increase fiscal transparency, while local societal and leadership factors have limited effects. These findings highlight the central role of institutional accountability in shaping fiscal transparency in hierarchical governance contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2013-2021年中国294个城市的财政公开数据，发现财政透明度主要由市场纪律和行政层级等外部问责机制驱动，而非社会需求或地方领导人的主动性，尤其是在缺乏选举问责的体制中。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动财政透明度？特别是在缺乏选举问责的威权或层级治理背景下，财政透明度主要由哪些力量决定？
AI.motivation: 财政透明度被认为是公共治理的基石，但其决定因素在学术界存在争议。现有研究多关注民主选举制度下的财政透明度，对非选举体制下财政透明度的驱动机制缺乏系统理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部问责理论（市场纪律与行政层级问责）vs. 社会需求与地方领导主动性
AI.method: 基于2013-2021年中国294个城市原始面板数据集，构建涵盖制度透明度、预算内透明度和预算外透明度的综合财政透明度指数，进行计量回归分析。
AI.findings: 市场暴露程度和层级监督显著提升了财政透明度；地方社会因素和领导层因素的推动作用有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"社会需求驱动透明度"的传统认知，揭示了在层级治理体制中，外部制度性问责（而非社会或个体因素）才是财政透明度的核心驱动力，拓展了财政透明度理论在非民主体制下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和威权体制下的财政改革提供了政策启示：提升财政透明度应着力强化市场约束和行政层级问责机制，而非单纯依赖社会参与或领导者个人意愿。

title: The Erosion of Territorial Sovereignty in Venezuela: From the Hybrid Armed State to Multilateral Kinetic Intervention Lise Working Paper Series | Security Governance & Transnational Law

detail.title: The Erosion of Territorial Sovereignty in Venezuela: From the Hybrid Armed State to Multilateral Kinetic Intervention Lise Working Paper Series | Security Governance & Transnational Law
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the historical collapse and systemic fragmentation of territorial sovereignty in the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, culminating in the recent kinetic neutralization of Héctor Rusthenford Guerrero Flores (alias "Niño Guerrero"), leader of the Tren de Aragua criminal cartel, in southern Venezuela through coordinated multilateral action. Confronting the constitutional text with empirical indicators of security governance, this analysis traces how the Venezuelan state systematically abdicated its Weberian monopoly on the legitimate use of physical force. This paper argues that the loss of sovereignty was not a sudden institutional failure, but rather a deliberate process of state hybridization that occurred across three distinct historical phases: the concession of sanctuary to Colombian insurgent groups (FARC/ELN), the deep institutional infiltration of foreign intelligence and logistical apparatuses (Cuba/Iran/Hezbollah), and the formal delegation of local territorial control to domestic criminal structures (Pranatos and Megabandas). Examined under the lens of the Venezuelan Constitution, UN declarations, and international criminal doctrine, the paper concludes that the multilateral operation against the Tren de Aragua leadership provides definitive legal and empirical proof of a fragmented sovereignty and criminal governance, transforming Venezuela from a classic Westphalian sovereign state into a contested regional security theater.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了委内瑞拉领土主权的历史崩溃与系统性碎片化，最终以多边联合行动在委内瑞拉南部对阿拉瓜火车犯罪卡特尔头目实施定点清除为顶点。论文认为主权丧失并非突发制度失灵，而是经过三个阶段的国家杂交化过程，最终将委内瑞拉从威斯特伐利亚主权国家转变为竞争性区域安全剧场。
AI.research_question: 委内瑞拉的主权为何以及如何从威斯特伐利亚式的完整主权国家碎片化、转化为竞争性区域安全剧场？多边行动对阿拉瓜火车领导人的清除如何提供了主权碎片化的法律与实证证据？
AI.motivation: 挑战将国家主权丧失简单归因于制度失灵的既有叙事，揭示委内瑞拉主权崩溃实际上是一个由国家主导的、分阶段的"国家杂交化"过程，从而更准确地理解当代非传统安全威胁下的主权理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韦伯关于国家合法垄断暴力的经典主权理论；威斯特伐利亚主权体系；国家杂交化理论；国际刑事法理与联合国相关宣言。
AI.method: 规范性文本（委内瑞拉宪法、联合国宣言、国际刑事学说）与经验性安全治理指标之间的对照分析；历史阶段分析与案例研究。
AI.findings: 委内瑞拉主权丧失经历了三个明确的历史阶段：向哥伦比亚叛乱组织（FARC/ELN）让渡庇护空间；外国情报与后勤机构（古巴/伊朗/真主党）的深度制度性渗透；将地方领土控制正式委托给国内犯罪结构（Pranatos和Megabandas）。多边行动对阿拉瓜火车领导人的清除证明了主权碎片化和犯罪治理的现实。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"国家杂交化"这一分析框架，以解释国家如何主动而非被动地丧失主权；揭示了主权碎片化是一个分阶段、有意图的政治过程，而非制度失灵的结果；丰富了威斯特伐利亚主权理论在面对非国家武装行为体（跨国犯罪组织、外国情报渗透）时的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会理解和应对委内瑞拉所代表的"碎片化主权"国家提供了分析工具；对多边联合行动打击跨国犯罪组织的主权法理依据提供了正当性辩护；为安全治理失效国家的政策制定者提供了预警框架。

reference: Forthcoming in (2026) Anuario de los Mercados y la Competencia
title: Public Enforcement against Restrictive Agreements: The Practice of the Spanish Competition Authority (2009-2025)
affiliations: and London School of Economics - Law School

detail.title: Public Enforcement against Restrictive Agreements: The Practice of the Spanish Competition Authority (2009-2025)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in (2026) Anuario de los Mercados y la Competencia

detail.abstract: This article analyses the evolution of the activity and the priorities of the Spanish Competition Authority when enforcing Articles 1 of Law 15/2007 and 101 of the TFEU. It considers the period between that followed the entry into force of Law 15/2007 until the end of 2025. It provides both a quantitative and a qualitative perspective of the Authority's practice. The article offers a comparative angle, with a particular emphasis on the European Commission's activity over the past two decades.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了西班牙竞争管理局在执行《西班牙竞争法》第1条和《欧洲联盟运作条约》第101条时的活动演变和优先事项变化，涵盖从2007年法律生效至2025年底的时期，并提供了定量与定性的视角，以及与欧盟委员会实践的对比分析。
AI.research_question: 西班牙竞争管理局在执行反垄断法（第1条和第101条）过程中，其执法活动和优先事项如何演变？
AI.motivation: 反垄断执法在国家层面和欧盟层面的互动日益重要，需要系统评估西班牙竞争管理局在长期内的执法实践变化，以理解其政策重点和效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法执行理论、反垄断执法优先序理论、欧盟与国家竞争法协同机制理论。
AI.method: 混合研究方法：定量分析（执法数据统计）与定性分析（案例和优先事项评估）相结合，辅以比较法视角（与欧盟委员会对比）。
AI.findings: 西班牙竞争管理局在2007年至2025年期间的执法重点和活动量发生了显著变化，其优先事项与欧盟委员会的实践既有趋同也有差异，反映了国家层面执法的独特路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国家竞争执法机构长期演进的实证研究，为竞争法执行优先序理论提供了来自西班牙的纵向证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和竞争执法机构提供了西班牙反垄断执法的演变全景，有助于理解国家与欧盟层面执法的分工与协调，对未来执法资源配置和优先事项设定具有参考价值。

reference: UC Irvine School of Law Research Paper No. 2026-12
title: A New Framework for Understanding Consent in Tort Law
affiliations: University of California, Irvine School of Law

detail.title: A New Framework for Understanding Consent in Tort Law

publicationDetails.detailsText: UC Irvine School of Law Research Paper No. 2026-12
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Irvine School of Law & Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Intentional torts such as battery, assault, and false imprisonment identify wrongful conduct that violates a person’s rights by intentionally and unjustifiably intruding upon the person’s autonomy, thereby causing physical harm, emotional harm, or dignitary offense. But when that person actually consents to such conduct, consent vitiates the wrong and justifiably precludes liability.

Yet consent is controversial and divisive. In the context of sexual conduct, consent provokes especially intense contemporary debate. In other contexts, too, disagreement abounds about the type of consent that is legally effective. Although the concept of consent in criminal law has been extensively explored, few scholars have thoroughly analyzed consent in tort law.

This article demonstrates that controversies about the proper content and scope of consent rest in part on a failure to appreciate the distinct doctrinal categories of consent that preclude tort liability. By distinguishing these categories and demonstrating their significance and interrelationship, this article permits a clearer articulation of the criteria for resolving the controversies and renders the controversies much more tractable.

The article identifies three different categories of consent that are independently sufficient to preclude tort liability and also notes two additional categories that are highly problematic. The first category is actual consent, or willingness that an actor engages in otherwise tortious conduct. The second is apparent consent, which refers to cases in which the actor reasonably believes, perhaps mistakenly, that the plaintiff actually consents. The third category is hypothetical or presumed consent, a category that courts and scholars have rarely identified and explained, except in a narrow subcategory (the emergency doctrine). Here, even if the actor knows that the plaintiff does not actually consent (e.g., because the plaintiff is asleep or unconscious or merely surprised by the actor’s conduct), the actor is sometimes justified in proceeding, so long as the actor has no reason to believe that the plaintiff would not have actually consented if the actor had requested such consent. A fourth possible category is implied-in-law or constructive consent, under which courts (in rare cases) preclude tort liability even if the plaintiff expresses objection to the actor’s conduct. I argue that this category should be jettisoned entirely. And a fifth possible category, implied consent simpliciter, is too vague and indiscriminate to be useful.

This framework is applied to numerous concrete scenarios, many drawn from the recently adopted Restatement Third, Torts: Intentional Torts to Persons. A separate section applies the analysis to contemporary controversies about the proper scope of consent to sexual conduct, including the question whether the bright-line rules “NO means NO” and “only YES means YES” (or affirmative consent) should be adopted.

The article is both a descriptive account of the concepts that are explicit or implicit in tort cases, and a normative account of the categories of consent that are most useful and justifiable to employ, consistent with the role of consent in tort doctrine and theory.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了侵权法中免除责任的三种同意类型（实际同意、表面同意、假设/推定同意），并批判了两种有问题的同意类型（拟制同意和模糊的默示同意），为性行为同意等争议问题提供了更清晰的分析框架。
AI.research_question: 侵权法中免除侵权责任的"同意"有哪些不同的类型？这些类型如何帮助我们解决当前关于同意内容的争议？
AI.motivation: 关于同意的内容与范围存在大量争议（特别是在性行为同意领域），但现有研究多集中在刑法领域，对侵权法中同意的系统性分析不足。学者们未能充分认识到侵权法中存在的不同同意类型，导致争议难以解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 同意理论；侵权法理论（故意侵权如殴打、攻击、非法拘禁中同意的免责功能）；分类分析方法。
AI.method: 概念分析与分类：识别并区分侵权法中不同类型的同意；规范分析：论证哪些同意类型最具合理性与实用性；案例应用：将框架应用于《侵权法重述第三版》中的具体场景及当代性行为同意争议。
AI.findings: 1. 独立且充分的三种同意类型：实际同意（当事人真实意愿）、表面同意（行为人有合理理由相信当事人同意）、假设/推定同意（当事人实际未同意，但行为人无理由相信其会拒绝）。2. 拟制同意（即便当事人明确反对仍免除责任）应被完全抛弃。3. 笼统的"默示同意"过于模糊，缺乏实用性。4. 该框架有助于澄清"NO就是NO"与"只有YES才是YES"等性行为同意规则的争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统识别并区分了侵权法中五种同意类型（三种有效类型+两种问题类型）；揭示了假设/推定同意这一被学界和法院长期忽视的独立类型（除紧急情况外）；为同意理论提供了更精细的概念工具，使争议更易于处理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院和立法者处理性行为同意争议（如肯定性同意标准）提供了分析框架；有助于律师在侵权案件中更准确地论证同意问题；批判了模糊的"默示同意"和"拟制同意"概念，推动法律实践的清晰化。

title: Pageants and the President: The Liability of Celebrity Politicians
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - School of Economics and Finance and

detail.title: Pageants and the President: The Liability of Celebrity Politicians
detail.abstract: We study when celebrity status becomes a liability for politicians once a scandal breaks, using the leak of the Access Hollywood tape during the 2016 U.S. presidential campaign and Donald Trump's prior two-decade ownership of the Miss USA pageant. Exploiting cohort-by-county variation in voters' pre-scandal exposure to Trump-as-the-pageant-owner, we find that the scandal produced a sharper attitudinal and electoral shift among voters with greater prior exposure, with the more exposed counties experiencing an additional decline in Trump's 2016 vote share. Our findings suggest voters' prior exposure to a candidate shapes how they attend to and interpret later political information.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2016年美国大选中《走进好莱坞》录音带丑闻及特朗普此前作为环球小姐选美比赛所有者的背景，发现选民对特朗普作为选美比赛所有者的预先暴露程度越大，丑闻对其态度和投票行为的负面影响越显著。这表明选民对候选人的先前接触影响他们如何关注和解读后续政治信息。
AI.research_question: 名人身份在政客丑闻爆发时何时会从资产变为负债？具体而言，选民对候选人作为名人的预先暴露如何影响其对丑闻的反应？
AI.motivation: 探讨名人政治家在丑闻情境下，其名人身份的双刃剑效应——即先前的正面/中性暴露如何在丑闻发生时放大负面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选民信息处理理论：先前接触塑造选民对信息的注意力和解读方式。
AI.method: 利用队列-县层面的变异，衡量选民在丑闻前对特朗普作为选美比赛所有者的暴露程度（基于其两 decade 的选美比赛所有权），结合2016年总统选举数据，分析丑闻前后的态度和投票行为变化。
AI.findings: 先前暴露程度越高的县，特朗普在2016年的得票率下降越明显；显着更尖锐的态度和选举变化出现在更早接触特朗普作为名人的选民中。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示名人政治家的"先验暴露"在丑闻中的调节作用，拓展了关于政治信息处理和候选人形象脆弱性的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政治竞选策略提供启示：候选人应警惕早期名人形象在后续丑闻中被重新诠释的风险；媒体和选民应对名人政治家的信息处理保持警觉。

title: Dual Specialisation or Divergent Paths? Sectoral Patterns of Tourism and Technology across European NUTS-3 Regions
affiliations: University of Alicante, Universidad de Oviedo - Economfa Aplicada, Universidad de Alicante - Department of Applied Economics and Political Economics and Universidad de Alicante - Department of Applied Economics and Political Economics

detail.title: Dual Specialisation or Divergent Paths? Sectoral Patterns of Tourism and Technology across European NUTS-3 Regions
detail.abstract: This paper examines the coexistence of tourism and technology across European NUTS-3 regions using Eurostat employment data for 2003-2023. A relative specialisation index is constructed to classify regions according to their sectoral profiles, and a Bai-Perron test identifies a structural break around 2010, allowing comparison between pre-and post-shock periods. The results show strong persistence in regional specialisation patterns, alongside moderate shifts away from dual-specialised configurations towards more asymmetric structures. Low-specialisation profiles dominate, particularly among lower-income regions, while higher-income regions are more frequently associated with technology-intensive and dual-specialisation patterns. Structural changes are sector-specific and income-dependent, with greater variability in tourism among lower-income regions and stronger technological dynamics in higher-income regions. Overall, tourism and technology are not mutually exclusive, but coexist within differentiated regional trajectories shaped by initial conditions and sectoral capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2003-2023年欧洲NUTS-3区域的就业数据，通过构建相对专业化指数和Bai-Perron结构断点检验，分析了旅游与技术在区域层面的共存模式。研究发现区域专业化格局具有高度持续性，但2010年后出现从双重专业化向非对称结构的适度转变；低专业化模式在低收入区域占主导，而高收入区域更常表现为技术密集型或双重专业化；结构变化具有部门特异性和收入依赖性。
AI.research_question: 欧洲NUTS-3区域中，旅游与技术产业是如何共存的？区域专业化模式在时间和空间上如何演变，且收入水平如何影响这些模式？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多将旅游与技术视为对立或替代关系，缺乏对二者在区域层面共存模式的系统实证分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示区域专业化结构的多维性和异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域专业化理论、结构断点理论、产业共存与演化经济地理学
AI.method: 使用Eurostat 2003-2023年NUTS-3层面就业数据；构建相对专业化指数对区域进行行业画像分类；采用Bai-Perron检验识别2010年前后的结构断点；对比分析断点前后区域专业化格局的变化。
AI.findings: 1）区域专业化格局具有高度持续性；2）2010年后出现从双重专业化向非对称结构的适度转变；3）低专业化模式在低收入区域占主导，高收入区域更常与技术密集型和双重专业化模式相关联；4）结构变化具有部门特异性和收入依赖性：低收入区域旅游部门波动更大，高收入区域技术动态更强；5）旅游与技术并非互斥，而是在初始条件和部门能力塑造的区域差异化路径中共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 为旅游与技术共存模式提供了系统的区域层面实证证据；验证了结构断点理论与区域专业化的关联；拓展了演化经济地理学视角下旅游与技术产业关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲区域产业政策制定提供参考，提示政策制定者应基于区域初始条件和收入水平制定差异化的旅游与技术协调发展战略。

title: Climate Stress and International Migration from MENA
affiliations: ,  and Migration Policy Group

detail.title: Climate Stress and International Migration from MENA
detail.abstract:
Existing research on the drivers of international migration is constrained by incomplete
measurement of volumes, directions and country coverage. Most studies focus on recent
decades, a narrow set of OECD destinations or a single flow type, even though categories
are blurred, new destinations have emerged and many developing countries now host large
migrant populations. Recent work suggests that migration drivers are best understood within
a broader migration system rather than in isolation. However, even in this newer literature,
long-run historical ties, such as deep ancestry links or very old migrant stocks, are still
rarely analyzed jointly with contemporary drivers and environmental pressures in a unified
empirical framework.
      In this paper, we focus on MENA countries and use bilateral flow estimates from Abel
(2018) in a gravity framework to analyse how environmental stress interacts with the broader
social, political, and historical structures that organise migration. We distinguish fast-onset
shocks, measured by the number of people affected by floods and storms, from slow-onset
anomalies, captured by 12-month SPEI indicators for unusually dry and unusually wet conditions.
These origin-year shocks have been analyzed in a rich context of civil conflict,
development, urbanization, and agrarian exposure, and we further augmented the study
with historical migrant stocks around 1960 and a new ancestry stock measure we developed,
reflects historical ties built up in the Colonial Era. This study is one of the first to
incorporate deep ancestry-based ties into an empirical analysis of migration from MENA.
      Our results show that fast-onset disasters affect emigration from MENA in a non-linear
way: small and moderate events are largely absorbed locally, while very severe shocks lead to
sharp increases in cross-border outflows. Deviations from normal moisture in either direction,
whether drought or excess rainfall, are also associated with higher emigration. In addition,
migrant stocks and ancestry links are strong and robust predictors of where migrants move,
even after we control for other conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用MENA国家的双边移民流数据，在引力模型框架下分析了环境冲击（快速灾害与缓慢气候异常）如何与冲突、发展、城市化等社会政治因素以及历史移民存量、殖民时期祖先联系共同驱动移民流动。研究发现：快速灾害对移民呈非线性影响（仅极端事件显著促进外流），干湿异常均增加移民，而历史联系（1960年存量、祖先纽带）是移民去向的强预测因子。
AI.research_question: 环境压力（快速灾害与缓慢气候异常）如何与历史联系（祖先纽带、早期移民存量）及其他社会政治因素共同影响MENA国家的国际移民流动？
AI.motivation: 现有国际移民驱动因素研究受限于数据不完整、覆盖时段短、目的地集中于OECD国家、忽视历史长期联系（如殖民时期祖先纽带）与环境压力的联合分析，本研究通过统一实证框架填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引力模型（Gravity Framework），整合移民系统理论（Migration System Theory），区分快速灾害（洪水、风暴）与缓慢气候异常（干湿SPEI指标），纳入历史存量、祖先纽带、冲突、发展、城市化等多元驱动因素。
AI.method: 使用Abel (2018)的MENA国家双边移民流估计数据，在引力模型中进行多元回归分析，加入快速灾害（受灾人数）、缓慢气候异常（12个月SPEI）、冲突、发展、城市化、农业暴露等变量，并创新性地构建殖民时期祖先联系指标，控制1960年历史移民存量。
AI.findings: （1）快速灾害对移民呈非线性影响：小规模灾害被本地吸收，仅极端灾害显著增加跨境流出；（2）干湿异常（干旱或过量降雨）均导致更高移民率；（3）历史移民存量和祖先联系是移民去向的强健预测因子，即使控制其他变量后依然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将深层祖先纽带（殖民时期历史联系）纳入MENA移民的实证分析，拓展了移民系统理论的历史维度；揭示了环境冲击与历史、社会、政治因素的交互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MENA地区及类似发展中国家的移民政策制定提供依据：需区分灾害类型与强度制定差异化应对策略，重视历史联系对移民网络的持续影响，以及气候变化对移民流的潜在催化作用。

title: Which Alignment Pays? Fiscal Patronage, Electoral Returns, and Local Party Dominance in Taiwan
affiliations: Hong Kong Metropolitan University and National Chengchi University (NCCU) - College of Social Sciences

detail.title: Which Alignment Pays? Fiscal Patronage, Electoral Returns, and Local Party Dominance in Taiwan
detail.abstract: Candidates in multilevel party systems face party labels that do not carry uniform value across territory. This article asks which forms of dominant-party alignment pay for regional legislative candidates. Drawing on candidate-election, candidate-panel, regional-dominance, and county-year fiscal data from Taiwan, it tests whether alignment is associated with fiscal-transfer gains, current electoral returns, later career continuation, and distinct payoff patterns in indigenous constituencies. The evidence indicates that regional-dominant alignment is associated with the clearest electoral and career returns, whereas national-tier-only alignment is weaker and fiscal-transfer evidence is limited. Indigenous constituencies display a different payoff structure, especially around independent candidacy. The article contributes to party politics by disaggregating alignment into competing payoff mechanisms and by showing that local organizational dominance can matter more for candidate viability than national dominance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文利用台湾数据，考察了多层级政党体制中不同形式的政党结盟（主导党结盟）对地区立法候选人的回报。研究发现，地区主导性结盟带来最清晰的选举和职业回报，而仅国家级结盟的回报较弱，财政转移支付的证据有限。原住民选区呈现出不同的回报结构。
AI.research_question: 在多层级政党体制中，哪种形式的主导党结盟对地区立法候选人最有利？
AI.motivation: 在多层级的政党体制中，候选人面临的政党标签在不同区域价值不同，但现有研究缺乏对不同层级结盟回报机制的细致分解和比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多层级政党体制、政党结盟（主导党结盟）、选举回报、职业延续理论。
AI.method: 综合运用候选人选举数据、候选人面板数据、地区主导性数据以及县级财政数据，对台湾地区进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）地区主导性结盟与最清晰的选举回报和职业延续相关；（2）仅国家级结盟的回报较弱；（3）财政转移支付方面的证据有限；（4）原住民选区呈现出不同的回报结构，尤其是独立候选方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政党结盟分解为相互竞争的回报机制，并证明地方组织主导性对候选人可持续性的影响可能超过国家层面的主导性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多层级政党体制下的候选人策略提供实证依据，帮助候选人和政党理解不同层级结盟的实际价值。

title: Beyond De-risking: Strategic Dependence as a Geopolitical Externality

detail.title: Beyond De-risking: Strategic Dependence as a Geopolitical Externality
detail.abstract:
Economic security has become a central concern in contemporary political economy, yet existing debates often focus on identifying vulnerabilities rather than explaining why strategically significant dependencies emerge and persist. This paper argues that strategic dependence should be understood as a geopolitical externality. Firms organize production and sourcing decisions according to private incentives that reward efficiency, specialization, and cost reduction, but some of the resulting risks are borne by consumers, governments, critical infrastructures, and society more broadly. Markets may therefore generate more strategic dependence than is socially optimal.

Drawing on the economics of externalities, the paper conceptualizes strategic dependence as a form of geopolitical market failure and reframes economic security as a problem of governing interdependence rather than reducing it. It develops a Strategic Dependence Index based on concentration, substitutability, and systemic impact, and applies the framework to rare-earth supply chains and advanced semiconductors. The analysis shows how strategically significant dependencies can be distinguished from ordinary commercial interdependence and identifies conditions under which public intervention may be justified.

AI.tldr: 本文提出战略依赖应被理解为一种地缘政治外部性：企业基于私人激励做出的生产和采购决策，会产生由社会承担的集中化风险。文章借鉴外部性经济学，将战略依赖概念化为一种地缘政治市场失灵，并基于集中度、可替代性和系统性影响构建了战略依赖指数，应用于稀土供应链和先进半导体案例。
AI.research_question: 为什么具有战略意义的依赖关系会出现并持续存在？如何区分战略依赖与普通商业相互依赖？
AI.motivation: 现有关于经济安全的讨论往往侧重于识别脆弱性，而非解释战略性依赖为何产生并持续存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部性经济学（地缘政治市场失灵）；将战略依赖视为企业私人激励与社会成本之间的错配。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建；提出战略依赖指数（基于集中度、可替代性、系统性影响三个维度）；案例应用（稀土供应链与先进半导体）。
AI.findings: 市场可能产生超出社会最优水平的战略依赖；可通过集中度、可替代性和系统性影响三个维度区分战略依赖与普通商业依赖；识别了公共干预的合理条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济安全重新定义为治理相互依赖而非减少相互依赖的问题；将外部性概念引入地缘政治经济学分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的战略依赖指数，帮助政策制定者识别哪些依赖关系具有战略意义并需要公共干预。

title: AEF-Econ: Toward Plug-and-Play Socioeconomic Foundation Embeddings from AlphaEarth for Urban Remote Sensing
affiliations: Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University and Wuhan University

detail.title: AEF-Econ: Toward Plug-and-Play Socioeconomic Foundation Embeddings from AlphaEarth for Urban Remote Sensing
detail.abstract: AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) unify global remote sensing foundation embeddings through multimodal self-supervised learning, but their pretraining focuses on physical land-surface signals, limiting plug-and-play use in socioeconomic tasks. We integrate seven heterogeneous data streams across 36 Chinese cities over eight years-AEF embeddings, population, nighttime lights, remote sensing indices, points of interest (POIs), urban morphology, and cross-lingual text-and construct CHN-Econ, a socioeconomic benchmark with 16 labels in three categories. We conduct 31 controlled experiments along five axes: fusion architecture, self-supervised objective, text integration, embedding dimensionality, and normalization. Used alone as a linear probe, AEF achieves R² values of only 0.301 for cross-region and 0.160 for cross-tier evaluation. The five-axis ablated backbone improves these scores to 0.832 and 0.671, respectively, but reveals that lowdimensional semantic streams are consistently suppressed by high-dimensional streams under shared reconstruction. To address this bottleneck, we propose Capacity-Adaptive Reconstruction (CAR), replacing shared reconstruction with per-stream decoders and stream-level losses to mitigate inter-stream capacity competition. CAR further raises cross-region and cross-tier R² to 0.848 and 0.693, and restores collapsed labels from negative R² to a stable range. Using CAR, we infer 14.4 million pixels across 36 cities and eight years and release AEF-Econ, including 128d and 64d compressed versions. Self-diagnostics and case studies show that AEF-Econ captures cross-city hierarchies and intra-urban spatial organization under unsupervised settings, providing a socioeconomic remote sensing foundation embedding complementary to AEF physical embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了CHN-Econ社会经济基准数据集，提出Capacity-Adaptive Reconstruction (CAR)方法解决多模态融合中的容量竞争问题，并发布了AEF-Econ社会经济遥感基础嵌入。
AI.research_question: 如何将遥感基础嵌入（AEF）从物理地表信号扩展到社会经济任务，并解决多模态数据融合中的维度竞争问题？
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础嵌入AEF专注于物理地表信号，在社会经济任务中即插即用性能有限。需构建社会经济基准并设计融合方法以弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态自监督学习、容量自适应重建、跨模态融合与维度竞争理论。
AI.method: 整合7种异构数据流（AEF、人口、夜间灯光、遥感指数、POI、城市形态、跨语言文本），构建CHN-Econ基准；提出CAR方法（逐流解码器+流级损失）替代共享重建；进行31项五轴控制实验。
AI.findings: AEF单独线性探测R²仅0.301（跨区域）和0.160（跨层级）；五轴消融提升至0.832和0.671；CAR进一步提至0.848和0.693，并恢复坍塌标签。AEF-Econ在无监督下捕捉了跨城市层级和城市内部空间结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多模态融合中低维语义流被高维流抑制的容量竞争机制；提出CAR方法有效缓解了这一瓶颈。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布了CHN-Econ基准数据集和AEF-Econ嵌入（含128d和64d压缩版），为社会经济遥感分析提供了即插即用的基础嵌入工具。

title: Data Under-Utilization with Privacy Concerns: Theory and Regulation
affiliations: and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU)

detail.title: Data Under-Utilization with Privacy Concerns: Theory and Regulation

declarations.funderStatement: Su and Xu’s research is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (72573108)

detail.abstract: Against the backdrop of extensive research on abuse of data, some empirical evidence suggests that platforms may not fully use their own level of data spontaneously. We model data governance as a platform-level service design problem: differentiated platforms choose data-utilization intensity, which raises cross-side network benefits for users of core platform services but imposes privacy costs on participating consumers. Under homogeneity and no privacy spillover, equilibrium intensity is systematically below the first-best because data-driven quality improvements benefit inframarginal participants while platforms monetize mainly through marginal participation (a Spence-Weyl wedge in data intensity). In the benchmark closed form, data intensity is independent of horizontal differentiation. The model also delivers a sharp pricing-structure implication: privacy-cost shocks pass through to consumer versus merchant fees according to cross-side externality asymmetry. We also conduct comparative static and welfare analysis, and compare two common regulations: command-and-control utilization standards may nonetheless reduce consumer surplus once platforms reoptimize access fees, whereas well-designed data pooling can improve consumer surplus locally when competition is strong. Finally, we extend the model to general privacy-type distributions, aggregate ecosystem privacy externalities jointly with platform heterogeneity in monetization efficiency, and free entry. This paper provides a new perspective on platform data governance through participation, pricing, and privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建平台数据治理模型，研究平台在数据利用强度上的决策及其对参与、定价和隐私的影响，发现均衡数据强度系统性低于最优水平（Spence-Weyl楔子），并分析了隐私成本冲击的定价传导、政策干预效果及扩展模型中的异质性问题。
AI.research_question: 平台应如何选择数据利用强度？该决策如何影响平台参与、定价和消费者隐私？
AI.motivation: 有实证证据表明平台并未充分利用自身数据，本文旨在从理论层面解释这一现象，并揭示平台数据治理的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边市场理论、Spence-Weyl楔子（边际参与vs边际内参与）、交叉网络外部性、平台差异化竞争
AI.method: 构建平台服务设计的理论模型，包含同质/异质消费者、隐私成本、平台竞争，进行均衡分析与比较静态，并扩展到一般隐私类型分布、聚合隐私外部性和自由进入。
AI.findings: 均衡数据利用强度系统性地低于社会最优水平（Spence-Weyl楔子）；在基准同质化假设下数据强度与水平差异化无关；隐私成本冲击按交叉网络外部性不对称性传导至消费者与商家收费；直接标准管制可能反而降低消费者剩余，而设计良好的数据池在竞争激烈时可改善消费者福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Spence-Weyl楔子扩展到数据利用强度决策，揭示了平台数据投资不足的结构性原因；将隐私成本与定价结构联系起来，提出隐私冲击的传导不对称性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台数据治理政策提供理论指导：简单利用强度标准可能适得其反，数据共享池在强竞争环境下可提升消费者福利，监管应关注定价传导效应。

title: Carbon Pricing and Investment
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Department of Finance, Stockholm University - Stockholm Business School, Swedish House of Finance and INDEK, Royal Institute of Technology (KTH)

detail.title: Carbon Pricing and Investment
detail.abstract: How does carbon pricing affect investment in brown firms? During the period 2000-2019, the effective cost of emitting carbon rose by about 400 percent for Swedish manufacturing firms. Despite lower operating margins, high-emission firms significantly increased both total capital investment and the share of investment dedicated to abatement. The response is concentrated among firms with strong internal financial capacity. We find no comparable investment increase in lower-emitting firms or in high-emission industries outside of Sweden. Our results show that pricing CO2 emissions at a sufficiently high level can incentivize brown firms to make green investments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了碳定价对棕型企业（高排放企业）投资行为的影响。基于2000-2019年瑞典制造业数据，发现尽管碳定价导致高排放企业运营利润率下降，但这些企业显著增加了总资本投资和减排投资占比，且这一效应集中在内部财务能力较强的企业。研究认为，足够高的碳定价能激励棕型企业进行绿色投资。
AI.research_question: 碳定价如何影响高排放（棕色）企业的投资决策？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对碳定价能否有效激励企业绿色转型存在争议，尤其缺乏对高排放企业实际投资行为的直接证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳定价理论、企业投资决策理论、内部财务能力约束理论
AI.method: 基于2000-2019年瑞典制造业企业面板数据，使用准自然实验方法，比较碳定价变化前后高排放与低排放企业的投资差异。
AI.findings: 1) 碳定价使高排放企业有效碳成本上升约400%；2) 尽管运营利润率下降，高排放企业总资本投资和减排投资占比均显著增加；3) 该效应集中在内部财务能力强的企业；4) 低排放企业和瑞典以外的高排放行业无类似投资增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了碳定价对企业微观行为影响的理论认识，揭示了企业异质性（内部财务能力）在碳政策传导中的关键调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明足够高的碳价格可以有效激励高排放企业进行绿色投资，同时提示政策设计需考虑企业财务能力差异。

title: An Analysis of Intellectual Property Rights in Nigeria’s Fashion Industry

detail.title: An Analysis of Intellectual Property Rights in Nigeria’s Fashion Industry

keywords: Counterfeiting and Piracy Fashion Industry Brand Protection

detail.abstract:
The protection of intellectual property rights in Nigeria's fashion sector is examined in this article, with particular attention to copyright, industrial design, trademarks, patent law, and the common law action of passing off. It contends that while Nigerian law offers a variety of legal safeguards, these regimes are both individually and collectively insufficient to completely protect commercial innovation and fashion originality.
The report also emphasizes issues like digital infringement, counterfeiting and the territorial nature of intellectual property rights. It comes to the conclusion that in order to improve the protection of innovation and investment in Nigeria's fashion industry, more enforcement and increased awareness are required.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了尼日利亚时尚产业的知识产权保护问题，指出尽管存在多种法律保护机制（版权、工业设计、商标、专利及仿冒诉讼），但这些制度无论单独还是整体均不足以充分保护商业创新与时尚原创性。研究还强调了数字侵权、假冒及知识产权的属地性等挑战，认为需要加强执法和提升意识以改善尼日利亚时尚产业的创新与投资保护。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚时尚产业的知识产权法律保护机制是否充分？存在哪些不足？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚时尚产业快速发展，但知识产权保护不足可能抑制创新与投资，亟需系统评估现有法律框架的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法理论，涵盖版权法、工业设计法、商标法、专利法及普通法中的仿冒诉讼（passing off）机制。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis），对尼日利亚现行知识产权法律体系进行文本与制度层面的批判性审视。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚法律虽提供多种知识产权保护途径，但无论是单独适用还是组合运用，均不足以充分保护时尚产业的商业创新与原创性；此外，数字侵权、假冒问题以及知识产权的属地性特征构成额外挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了发展中国家时尚产业中多重知识产权制度并存但协同失效的理论困境，丰富了关于知识产权"制度叠加"与保护缺口的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚及其他类似发展中国家提出了加强执法力度与提升公众知识产权意识的具体政策建议，以促进时尚产业创新与投资保护。

title: Can Automation Offset Population Decline? Occupational Imbalances in a Shrinking Workforce
affiliations: and Bank of Korea

detail.title: Can Automation Offset Population Decline? Occupational Imbalances in a Shrinking Workforce
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether automation can mitigate the labor-market effects of population decline and how this mitigation differs across occupations. Korea's working-age population is projected to fall by about 11 percent between 2024 and 2034. Holding current occupational demand fixed, we first project occupation-level labor-supply imbalances using Korean population projections and age-by-occupation employment data. We then estimate occupation-level automation probabilities by applying a large language model (LLM) to O*NET task statements and mapping the resulting task-level measures to Korean occupations. Automation can substantially reduce the aggregate labor shortfall, but it does not eliminate occupational imbalance because automation potential is only weakly aligned with projected demographic shortages. The main implication is therefore compositional: population decline changes the distribution of labor scarcity, while automation changes where shortages persist and where surplus pressure emerges. With sufficiently rapid AI progress, the same framework implies that the policy problem may shift from aggregate labor shortage to the distribution of labor surplus across occupations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动化能否缓解人口下降对劳动力市场的影响，以及这种缓解作用在不同职业间的差异。基于韩国人口预测数据，作者发现自动化能显著减少总劳动力缺口，但由于自动化潜力与人口短缺的关联较弱，无法消除职业间的不平衡。
AI.research_question: 自动化能否缓解人口下降带来的劳动力市场效应？这种缓解作用如何在不同职业间存在差异？
AI.motivation: 韩国劳动年龄人口预计在2024-2034年间下降约11%，这可能引发严重的劳动力短缺问题。理解自动化能否以及如何弥补这一缺口，对政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力供需模型、职业自动化潜力评估（基于LLM和O*NET任务数据）、人口结构与职业分布的交叉分析。
AI.method: 1. 使用韩国人口预测数据和年龄-职业就业数据，测算各职业的劳动力供给缺口。2. 利用大语言模型（LLM）分析O*NET任务描述，估计各职业的自动化概率。3. 将自动化潜力与人口下降导致的劳动力短缺进行匹配分析。
AI.findings: 1. 自动化能大幅降低总劳动力缺口。2. 但自动化无法消除职业间的不平衡，因为自动化潜力与人口短缺的关联较弱。3. 人口下降改变劳动力稀缺的分布，自动化则改变了短缺和过剩压力出现的职业分布。4. 若AI进步足够快，政策问题可能从总劳动力短缺转向劳动力过剩的职业分布问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将自动化潜力与人口结构变化导致的劳动力供需失衡进行交叉分析，揭示了自动化在缓解劳动力短缺方面的结构性限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临人口下降的国家（如韩国）提供政策启示：自动化不是万能药，需关注职业间的结构性失衡；政策重点可能需从"总量短缺"转向"结构性过剩"。

title: AI-driven Versus Econometric Supply Chain Simulation for Nearshoring Resilience in Mexico
affiliations: UNAM and Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Mexico

detail.title: AI-driven Versus Econometric Supply Chain Simulation for Nearshoring Resilience in Mexico
detail.abstract: This study applies explainable artificial intelligence-gradient boosting and SHAP value decomposition-to evaluate policies that strengthen supply chain resilience, a core dimension of economic sustainability, across Mexico's 32 states as a representative emerging-market economy facing distinct infrastructure and financial frictions. Since 2023, Mexico has surpassed China as the leading source of US goods imports, yet infrastructure constraints threaten regional capacity to capture the nearshoring wave. We compare two agent-based models sharing identical architecture (32 states, 2017-2024, twelve resilience scenarios) that differ only in the production engine: a Cobb-Douglas specification estimated via panel econometrics versus a gradient boosting model (R 2 = 0.91). The ML engine outperforms the econometric benchmark on five of nine empirical moments with no total failures, produces more consistent policy rankings across 50 random seeds (68% convergence on supplier development as top-ranked versus a scattered distribution), and-via SHAP-discovers nonlinear infrastructure thresholds invisible to the constant-elasticity specification. The econometric model shows greater sensitivity to extreme shocks, but this reflects a binary recovery artefact rather than nuanced dynamics. For AI-powered supply chain analytics in emerging markets, the ML engine is the recommended default; the comparison identifies specific extrapolation boundaries where caution is warranted.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用可解释人工智能（梯度提升+SHAP值分解）评估墨西哥32个州的供应链韧性政策，比较了两种基于主体的模型（Cobb-Douglas计量经济学模型 vs. 梯度提升机器学习模型），发现机器学习模型在拟合度、政策排序一致性和非线性阈值发现方面均优于传统计量模型，建议在新兴市场的供应链分析中优先采用机器学习引擎。
AI.research_question: 在新兴市场（以墨西哥32个州为例）中，如何评估和比较不同政策对供应链韧性的影响？机器学习模型是否优于传统计量经济学模型？
AI.motivation: 墨西哥自2023年起超过中国成为美国最大商品进口来源国，但基础设施瓶颈制约了其承接近岸外包的能力。传统计量模型可能无法捕捉供应链韧性政策的非线性效应，需要引入可解释人工智能方法进行更精准的政策评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链韧性理论、可解释人工智能（XAI）、梯度提升算法、SHAP值分解、基于主体的建模（ABM）、Cobb-Douglas生产函数
AI.method: 构建两个结构相同的基于主体模型（32个州，2017-2024年，12种韧性情景），唯一差异在于生产引擎：一组采用面板计量估计的Cobb-Douglas函数，另一组采用梯度提升模型（R²=0.91）。通过9个经验矩对比模型表现，使用50个随机种子评估政策排序稳定性，并利用SHAP值发现非线性基础设施阈值。
AI.findings: 1）机器学习引擎在9个经验矩中有5个优于计量基准模型，且无完全失败情况；2）机器学习产生更一致的政策排序（68%的概率将供应商发展列为最优政策，而计量模型排序分散）；3）SHAP揭示了计量模型无法识别的非线性基础设施阈值；4）计量模型对极端冲击更敏感，但这反映的是二元恢复假象而非真实的复杂动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将可解释人工智能方法引入供应链韧性政策评估，拓展了XAI在运营管理领域的应用；2）实证发现传统常弹性计量模型无法捕捉供应链韧性的非线性特征，挑战了传统方法在复杂系统建模中的适用性边界；3）揭示了基础设施的非线性阈值效应，丰富了对供应链韧性驱动因素的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为新兴市场政策制定者提供了基于机器学习的供应链韧性评估工具，特别适用于墨西哥等面临近岸外包机遇的国家；2）建议优先使用机器学习引擎进行供应链分析，同时指出了需要谨慎的外推边界；3）明确了供应商发展政策是提升供应链韧性的最优先选项，为政策资源分配提供决策依据。

detail.abstract: I wanted to find out whether what CEOs post on X actually makes their company's stock move more than usual. I also wanted to know if CEOs with more followers cause bigger effects than CEOs with fewer followers. To study this I collected 121 posts from five CEOs between 2020 and 2026: Elon Musk (Tesla), Dana White (TKO/UFC), Bob Iger (Disney), Brian Chesky (Airbnb), and Jamie Dimon (JPMorgan). I scored each post as positive, negative, or neutral using a free tool called VADER. Before I ran VADER I coded 50 random posts myself to check whether it was working right, and I agreed with VADER 74% of the time. I then measured how much more or less each stock moved in the two days after each post compared to normal. When I ran the regression the only thing that came back significant was the overall market volatility index called the VIX (p=0.015). The CEO sentiment and follower count variables were not significant. I explain in the paper why I think this happened and what a better study would need to do differently.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了五位CEO在X平台上的帖子（2020-2026年，共121条），发现CEO发帖的情绪和粉丝数量对股票异常波动无显著影响，只有市场整体波动指数（VIX）显著相关。
AI.research_question: CEO在X平台上的发帖是否会导致公司股价异常波动？粉丝更多的CEO是否会产生更大的影响？
AI.motivation: 随着CEO越来越多地通过社交媒体直接发声，研究者希望验证这种"CEO社交媒体效应"是否真实存在，以及影响程度是否与CEO的粉丝基数相关。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号传递理论（Signal Theory）、社交媒体影响力理论、市场效率假说
AI.method: 收集5位CEO（Elon Musk、Dana White、Bob Iger、Brian Chesky、Jamie Dimon）在2020-2026年间的121条X帖子；使用VADER工具进行情绪评分（正/负/中性），并自行编码50条帖子进行一致性检验（74%一致率）；测量帖子发布后两天的股票异常波动；通过回归分析检验CEO情绪、粉丝数量与股价波动的关系。
AI.findings: CEO发帖的情绪（sentiment）和粉丝数量（follower count）对股票异常波动的影响均不显著；唯一显著的解释变量是市场整体波动指数VIX（p=0.015），即股价波动更多由市场整体环境驱动，而非CEO的社交媒体行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 对"CEO社交媒体效应"理论提出了实证挑战，表明在控制市场整体波动后，CEO的发帖行为可能被高估；为信号传递理论在社交媒体情境下的适用性提供了边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供实证依据：不必过度关注CEO个人社交媒体的短期市场影响；为CEO和公关团队提供参考：发帖对股价的直接影响可能有限，应更关注市场整体环境。

title: Information Selling under Prior Disagreement
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Information Selling under Prior Disagreement
detail.abstract: We study monopolistic information selling under prior disagreement and limited intertemporal commitment. A Seller offers experiments to a Buyer over multiple periods. Under a common prior, sequential information selling does not increase revenue. By contrast, under prior disagreement, revenue maximization requires sequential selling. Moreover, for generic prior beliefs, the Seller’s revenue strictly increases with the length of the interaction. Yet, expected revenue remains bounded by the payoff achievable under commitment with non-negative state-contingent payments. In some environments, optimal information-selling strategies involve an initial free experiment. Paternalistic policies that restrict free samples or gradual information provision improve the Buyer’s welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在事前意见分歧和有限跨期承诺下，垄断者如何通过多期售卖信息（实验）给买方以最大化收益。研究发现：共同先验下顺序售卖不增加收益；而事前分歧下，顺序售卖能严格提升收益，且收益随交互期数增加而严格递增，但最终受限于承诺状态下非负状态或有支付的可实现收益。最优策略可能包含初始免费实验，而限制免费样本或渐进信息披露的父爱主义政策可改善买方福利。
AI.research_question: 在买方和卖方存在事前意见分歧且卖方仅有有限跨期承诺能力的情况下，垄断卖方如何通过多期顺序出售信息（实验）来实现收益最大化？
AI.motivation: 传统的垄断信息售卖文献通常假设共同先验或完全承诺，但现实中的信息卖方（如数据经纪商、咨询公司）常面临买方先验不同且难以一次性承诺所有未来信息销售策略的困境。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯说服（Bayesian Persuasion）、信息设计、动态契约理论、事前分歧下的信息交易模型。
AI.method: 理论模型分析。构建多期信息销售博弈模型，比较共同先验与事前分歧下的最优策略，分析有限承诺下的顺序销售收益特征。
AI.findings: 1) 共同先验下顺序出售信息不增加收益；2) 事前分歧下顺序出售能严格提升收益，且交互期数越多收益越高；3) 收益存在上限（等于承诺下非负状态或有支付的可实现收益）；4) 最优策略可能包含初始免费实验；5) 父爱主义政策（限制免费样本或渐进披露）能改善买方福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统刻画了事前分歧和有限承诺对垄断信息销售收益的影响，揭示了顺序销售在分歧先验下的独特价值，并建立了收益上限的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据经纪、咨询服务、金融信息销售等行业的定价策略提供理论指导；为监管机构设计保护信息买方（消费者）福利的政策（如限制免费试用、强制渐进披露）提供依据。

title: Regulatory Challenges in Cross-Border Mergers and Acquisitions: A Comparative Analysis of the UK and the US

detail.title: Regulatory Challenges in Cross-Border Mergers and Acquisitions: A Comparative Analysis of the UK and the US

keywords: UK CMA Voluntary Merger Control Regime
Innovation-Based Theories of Harm in Antitrust
Post-Brexit Merger Control UK Vs US

detail.abstract:
This research examines the effect of competition law and national security–driven investment screening on mergers and acquisitions between the United Kingdom and the United States. It analyses agency guidance, statutory frameworks, and case studies using a doctrinal and comparative methodology.

The study finds that both jurisdictions engage similar substantive standards; however, there is a sharp difference between their procedural and institutional structures. The UK allows the Competition and Markets Authority to interfere flexibly through its voluntary and non-suspensory merger regime, especially in innovation-driven markets. The US system, however being anchored in Hart–Scott–Rodino pre-notification and judicial enforcement, showcases greater scepticism towards speculative theories of harm and demands higher evidentiary thresholds. In national security, the UK’s National Security and Investment Act 2021 and the US’s CFIUS regime both give regulatory agencies extensive discretion, extending well beyond traditional antitrust concerns.

The research contributes significantly to legal scholarship in many ways. Primarily, it deals with a post-Brexit gap by contrasting the two jurisdictions’ approaches to merger control and investment screening systematically. Secondly, it highlights how uncertainty and extraterritorial effects in high-value transactions are created because of overlapping competition and security regimes. Finally, it proposes policy recommendations such as clearer guidance on innovation-based theories of harm, improved cross-border harmonisation of remedies, and better transparency in security assessments.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了英美两国在竞争法和国家安全驱动投资审查下的并购监管框架，发现两者实质标准相似但程序与制度结构存在显著差异，并提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 竞争法与国家安全投资审查如何影响英美之间的并购交易？两国的监管框架存在哪些异同？
AI.motivation: 脱欧后英国监管体系变化，加上国家安全审查与竞争法在并购领域日益重叠，产生跨域监管不确定性与域外效应，亟需系统性比较分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争法理论、国家安全审查理论、比较法方法论、并购监管制度理论。
AI.method: 采用教义学（doctrinal）与比较法方法论，分析机构指南、法定框架及案例研究。
AI.findings: （1）两国实质标准相似，但程序与制度结构差异显著；（2）英国CMA通过自愿非暂停制度灵活干预创新驱动市场；（3）美国HSR申报与司法执行模式对投机性损害理论更谨慎，证据门槛更高；（4）国家安全方面，英国NSI法案2021与美国CFIUS均赋予监管机构广泛裁量权，远超传统反垄断范畴。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了脱欧后英美两国并购控制与投资审查系统性比较的学术空白；揭示了竞争与安全双重制度叠加在高价值交易中造成的不确定性与域外效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策建议：明确创新损害理论的指导、改进跨境救济协调、提升安全评估透明度。

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it is based exclusively on publicly available documents and secondary sources and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects.
