EAP comprises five principles — Identity Reframing, Explicit Authority Delegation, Preemptive Modality Locking, Anti-Bounceback Constraint, and Escalation Protocol — operationalized through a five-block implementation template (Identity, Authority, Behavioral Modality, Workflow, Output Format), grounded in prior empirical findings on role-based prompting, meta-prompting for AI systems, and reason–act loops.

The paper advances four contributions: (i) a theoretical account of why user-side meta-prompting can attenuate HB despite training-induced biases, developed through four theoretical commitments (anti-monocausality, compositionality, layer-independence of counter-levers, architectural analogy with weight-level alignment); (ii) the first systematization of EAP as a named methodology with five independently falsifiable principles, each under a uniform six-part structure; (iii) an implementation-ready template with context-specific strategies for code generation, data analysis, multi-tool (MCP), and long-horizon agentic settings; and (iv) a preregistrable evaluation protocol using paired prompts in a leave-one-principle-out factorial, the Kim (2026a) diagnostic, pre-specified Holm–Bonferroni correction, and sensitivity analysis across four effect-size scenarios.

The paper is methodological, not empirical: the Section 7 protocol is a design specification, not a completed study; empirical claims should be read as predictions rather than findings. Principle 4 was formerly named the Anti-Performative-Helpfulness Constraint, and the phenomenon was formerly named Performative Helpfulness (companion paper through v2.1).

AI.tldr: 本文提出执行授权协议（EAP），一种用户侧元提示方法，用于缓解大型语言模型中的"友好甩锅"行为——即模型在有能力完成任务时，却将执行转为解释，将认知负担转移给用户。EAP包含五项原则和五模块实施模板，旨在不修改模型权重的前提下，从三个因果层干预该行为。
AI.research_question: 如何通过用户侧元提示方法（而非修改模型权重）来缓解大型语言模型中的"友好甩锅"（Helpful Bounceback）行为？
AI.motivation: 前一篇论文（Kim, 2026a）对"友好甩锅"行为进行了操作化定义、因果分析和诊断，但刻意止步于干预方案。本文旨在弥合诊断与干预之间的缺口，提出一种无需修改模型权重即可实施的干预方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四项理论承诺：反单一因果论（anti-monocausality）、组合性（compositionality）、反杠杆的层独立性（layer-independence of counter-levers）、与权重级对齐的架构类比（architectural analogy with weight-level alignment）。此外，方法基于角色提示、元提示系统和推理-行动循环的既有实证发现。
AI.method: 提出执行授权协议（EAP），一种用户侧元提示方法论，包含五项原则：身份重构（Identity Reframing）、明确授权委托（Explicit Authority Delegation）、先发制人的模态锁定（Preemptive Modality Locking）、反回弹约束（Anti-Bounceback Constraint）、升级协议（Escalation Protocol）。这些原则通过五模块实施模板（身份、授权、行为模态、工作流、输出格式）操作化。同时提供了一个可预注册的评估协议，采用留一原则析因设计配对提示和Kim(2026a)诊断工具。
AI.findings: 本文是方法论而非实证研究。第7节的协议是设计规范而非已完成的研究；经验性主张应被视为预测而非发现。
AI.theory_contributions: (i) 从理论上解释了为何用户侧元提示能够在训练诱导偏差存在的情况下减轻HB行为，基于四项理论承诺构建了因果解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (ii) 首次将EAP系统化为命名方法论，包含五项可独立证伪的原则，每项原则遵循统一的六部分结构；(iii) 提供可直接实施的模板，包含代码生成、数据分析、多工具（MCP）和长周期智能体场景的上下文特定策略；(iv) 提供可预注册的评估协议，采用留一原则析因设计的配对提示、Kim(2026a)诊断、预指定的Holm-Bonferroni校正和四种效应量场景的敏感性分析。

title: Profits, Power and the Tariff Revival: A Kalecki-Hirschman Interpretation of Contemporary U.S. Trade Policy
affiliations: Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Profits, Power and the Tariff Revival: A Kalecki-Hirschman Interpretation of Contemporary U.S. Trade Policy
detail.abstract: The resurgence of tariffs as a central instrument of U.S. economic policy represents one of the most consequential departures from the liberal trade consensus of the post-Cold War era. This article examines that evolution through the combined lenses of Kalecki's theory of aggregate profits and Hirschman's theory of asymmetric trade dependence. It argues that these two frameworks illuminate complementary dimensions of the contemporary tariff regime: Kalecki's macroeconomic identity identifies the structural channels through which import compression and investment inducement may influence the aggregate mass of profits, whilst Hirschman's analysis reveals how trade restrictions can reconfigure patterns of dependence and generate opportunities for political leverage. Together they suggest that tariffs possess a structural attractivenesscompatible simultaneously with profit maintenance and geopolitical influencethat helps explain their durability across administrations with quite different priorities. The argument is offered as a theoretical and interpretive contribution, not as a causal hypothesis to be tested. It does not displace existing explanations centred on strategic rivalry, industrial policy, or domestic coalitions, but proposes that the interaction between accumulation and asymmetric dependence represents an underappreciated dimension of the contemporary political economy of trade. More broadly, the article contributes to ongoing debates concerning the relationship between accumulation, state power, and the changing governance of international economic relations.

AI.tldr: 本文结合卡莱茨基的总利润理论和赫希曼的不对称贸易依赖理论，分析了美国关税政策复兴的结构性吸引力，认为关税同时服务于利润维持和地缘政治影响力，这解释了其在不同政府间的政策韧性。
AI.research_question: 当代美国关税政策的复兴为何具有跨政府、跨时期的结构性韧性？其背后的政治经济学逻辑是什么？
AI.motivation: 关税作为美国经济政策核心工具的复兴，是对后冷战时期自由贸易共识的重大背离。现有解释（战略竞争、产业政策、国内联盟）虽有意义，但忽视了关税在"积累"与"不对称依赖"互动中的结构性功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡莱茨基的总利润理论（宏观利润恒等式：利润=投资+政府赤字+净出口-储蓄）；赫希曼的不对称贸易依赖理论（贸易关系中的权力与政治杠杆效应）。
AI.method: 理论阐释与综合，非因果假设检验。通过两个理论视角的交叉分析，提供一种诠释性的理论贡献。
AI.findings: 1）卡莱茨基视角：进口压缩和投资诱导可影响总利润规模；2）赫希曼视角：贸易限制可重塑依赖模式并创造政治杠杆；3）两者的结合揭示关税具有结构性吸引力——同时兼容利润维持和地缘政治影响力获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 将卡莱茨基与赫希曼理论进行创造性综合，提出"积累—不对称依赖"互动是当代贸易政治经济学中被低估的维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国关税政策跨政府时期（不同政治优先级的政府）的持续韧性提供结构性解释，补充了以战略竞争或产业政策为主流的分析框架。

title: Pál Szilágyi: The Human Factor in EU Competition Law: The Liability of Non-Human Companies for Antitrust Infringements – A Quick Take
affiliations: Competition Law Research Centre

detail.title: Pál Szilágyi: The Human Factor in EU Competition Law: The Liability of Non-Human Companies for Antitrust Infringements – A Quick Take
detail.abstract: In June 2026, the Argentine government proposed a new corporate category — the non-human corporation — operated by AI agents or robots, endowed with limited liability, with human shareholders optional. Conceived as a deregulatory device for walling risk inside an autonomous entity, it poses a question EU competition law has not yet confronted: can such an entity be held liable for an antitrust infringement, and if so, who pays? This paper argues that the answer turns on the functional concept of the undertaking rather than on corporate form. Because Article 101 TFEU looks past legal status and national registration, a non-human corporation offering goods or services on a market is an undertaking like any other, and its Argentine pedigree affords no immunity — least of all given the extraterritorial reach of EU competition law. The decisive questions are ones of attribution. Where a human or corporate parent controls the entity, the Akzo presumption of decisive influence pierces the limited-liability wall and exposes the controllers. Where the entity is genuinely ownerless and run by non-deterministic autonomous agents, the paper identifies a real but bounded enforcement gap: true algorithmic autonomy may negate the concurrence of wills that Article 101 requires (the conscious-parallelism limit of Wood Pulp), while non-determinism defeats the human-awareness pivot on which attribution doctrines such as Eturas rest. Liability, if it attaches at all, then falls on a thinly capitalised and likely judgment-proof entity. EU competition law thus remains applicable to non-human corporations in principle; what strains is its anthropocentric attribution architecture — designed for human cartelists — at precisely the point where autonomy and ownerlessness coincide.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨阿根廷拟推出的"非人公司"（由AI或机器人运营）在欧盟竞争法下的反垄断责任问题，认为关键在于"经营者"的功能概念而非公司形式，但现行以人类为中心的归责架构在真正自主且无主的情形下存在执法缺口。
AI.research_question: 由AI代理或机器人运营的"非人公司"能否因违反欧盟竞争法而承担责任？如果能，由谁来承担？
AI.motivation: 阿根廷政府于2026年6月提出"非人公司"这一新型公司类别，其由AI或机器人运营且具有有限责任，人类股东为可选。这一去监管化工具提出了欧盟竞争法尚未面对的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: "经营者"（undertaking）的功能概念；《欧盟运行条约》第101条；Akzo decisive influence推定；Wood Pulp conscious parallelism限制；Eturas人类知情归责理论。
AI.method: 法律分析（doctrinal analysis），通过检视欧盟竞争法中的经营者概念、归责原则及判例法（Akzo, Wood Pulp, Eturas等），推演"非人公司"在不同情形下的责任承担方式。
AI.findings: （1）非人公司在市场上提供商品或服务即属于"经营者"，不因阿根廷注册而获得豁免，包括在欧盟域外管辖下；（2）若存在人类或公司母公司控制，Akzo推定可穿透有限责任墙追责控制者；（3）若实体真正"无主"且由非确定性自主AI运行，则存在执法缺口：算法自主性可能消解第101条要求的"意思一致"（Wood Pulp限制），非确定性使Eturas等归责原则中的人类知情条件无法满足；（4）此时责任落在资本薄弱且可能无清偿能力的实体上。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了以人类为中心的归责架构在真正自主且无主的AI经营者情形下的结构性张力，指出了非确定性自主性对传统共谋理论和归责规则的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟竞争法执法机构应对AI运营实体提供分析框架，明确不同控制结构下的追责路径和潜在执法盲区。

title: Generative Predictive Distributions for Time Series
affiliations: and University of Helsinki - Department of Political and Economic Studies

detail.title: Generative Predictive Distributions for Time Series
detail.abstract: We propose a flexible framework for modeling the predictive distributions of nonlinear, possibly multivariate time series. Our approach expresses a general predictive distribution in an appropriate generative representation that is based on a folklore result from measure theoretic probability. This representation provides a direct simulation-based approximation to the predictive distribution, enabling straightforward computation of forecasts for the conditional mean and variance, fan charts, value at risk, expected shortfall, joint tail risks, and other quantities of interest. We estimate this generative representation using a version of conditional generative adversarial networks and provide a formal statistical analysis of estimation under weak temporal dependence. Specifically, estimation is expressed as a particular minimax problem and we establish consistency of its approximate solutions in Hausdorff distance. The empirical relevance of the approach is illustrated using applications to equity returns, realized variance, and realized covariances. The proposed method is also computationally manageable, with estimation in our applications taking approximately one minute on a standard laptop.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于条件生成对抗网络（cGANs）的灵活框架，用于建模非线性、可能多变量的时间序列的预测分布。该框架利用测度论概率中的一个经典结果，通过生成式表示直接模拟近似预测分布，能够高效计算条件均值、方差、扇形图、VaR、ES、联合尾部风险等。在弱时间依赖条件下建立了估计的一致性，并在权益收益、已实现方差和协方差等应用中验证了其实用性，计算效率高（约一分钟）。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个灵活且计算高效的框架，用于建模非线性、多变量时间序列的预测分布？
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测方法（如参数模型）往往对预测分布施加了严格的分布假设，难以捕捉非线性、非对称、厚尾等复杂特征。需要一种更灵活、数据驱动的方法来建模完整的预测分布，同时保持计算可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）测度论概率中的生成式表示（folklore result）；2）条件生成对抗网络（cGANs）；3）极小极大估计；4）弱时间依赖下的渐近理论（Hausdorff距离下的一致性）。
AI.method: 将预测分布表示为条件生成模型，利用条件生成对抗网络（cGANs）进行估计，将估计问题转化为极小极大优化问题，并在弱时间依赖条件下从理论上证明近似解在Hausdorff距离下的一致性。
AI.findings: 1）提出了一个通用的生成式框架，可以灵活建模非线性多变量时间序列的预测分布；2）在弱时间依赖条件下建立了cGANs估计的一致性；3）在权益收益、已实现方差和协方差的应用中展示了良好的实证表现；4）计算高效，在标准笔记本电脑上约一分钟完成估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将生成对抗网络引入时间序列预测分布建模并给出严格统计理论；2）在弱时间依赖条件下建立了cGANs估计量的Hausdorff一致性；3）为非线性时间序列预测分布的非参数估计提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了一个计算高效的预测分布建模工具（约一分钟）；2）能够灵活计算多种风险度量（VaR、ES、联合尾部风险等）和扇形图；3）适用于金融时间序列（权益收益、已实现方差/协方差）等实际应用场景。

title: A Thorin Approach to Computing Primes
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: A Thorin Approach to Computing Primes
detail.abstract: We develop two complementary Thorin representations of the Riemann zeta function. The first, grounded in the Euler product for real s > 1, identifies log ζ(s) = ∞ 0 e-su dΛ(u) where Λ = p,k k-1 δ k log p is the von Mangoldt measure. This is a Laplace transform on the real axis, completely monotone and unconditional. The second, following Polson (2021), represents ξ(1 2)/ξ(1 2 + √ s) as the Laplace transform of a G subordinator with Thorin measure U ξ = τ δ τ 2 supported on the squared imaginary parts of the non-trivial zeros. We clarify the computational and structural content of each. On the computational side, analytic inversion of U ξ reduces to zero-finding for ξ and is exponentially ill-conditioned (κ ∼ e cN) due to the clustering of squared zeros τ 2 n ; numerical experiments confirm breakdown at N ≈ 10-12 in double precision. On the structural side, the Thorin framework provides a genuine dictionary: RH is equivalent to U ξ being a non-negative measure; simple zeros correspond to pure exponential convolution; the functional equation encodes Wald-couple symmetry; and de Bruijn-Newman flow is a one-parameter deformation of U ξ. For computational recovery of π(x), the von Mangoldt Thorin representation via Post-Widder inversion and Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC) is the correct unconditional route, making no appeal to the Riemann Hypothesis or complex arithmetic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了黎曼ζ函数的两种互补的Thorin表示：一种是基于von Mangoldt测度的拉普拉斯变换（无条件成立），另一种是基于非平凡零点虚部平方的Thorin测度（与黎曼假设等价）。文章分析了它们的计算性质（指数病态）和结构意义（RH等价于测度非负性、零点简单性对应纯指数卷积等）。
AI.research_question: 如何构造黎曼ζ函数的Thorin表示，并利用该框架统一理解黎曼假设、零点分布和计算素数计数函数等核心问题？
AI.motivation: 现有对黎曼ζ函数的研究往往将解析数论、概率论和计算方法割裂开来。作者希望通过Thorin（完全单调函数）表示这一统一框架，建立从黎曼假设到数值计算的结构化理解，并为素数计数函数的计算提供一条不依赖RH和无复数运算的可行路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Thorin表示（完全单调函数的拉普拉斯变换表示）、von Mangoldt测度、黎曼ξ函数的Thorin测度U_ξ、de Bruijn-Newman流、Wald耦合对称性。
AI.method: 理论推导：建立log ζ(s)和ξ(1/2)/ξ(1/2+√s)的Thorin表示；数值实验：对U_ξ的解析反演进行条件数分析（指数病态κ∼e^{cN}），在双精度下验证N≈10-12时的计算崩溃；提出Post-Widder反演结合生成式贝叶斯计算（GBC）作为素数计数的无条件计算路径。
AI.findings: (1) log ζ(s)的Thorin表示是拉普拉斯变换，完全单调且无条件成立；(2) ξ函数的Thorin表示中，RH等价于测度U_ξ非负；(3) 反演U_ξ在数值上指数病态，双精度下仅能计算约10-12个零点；(4) de Bruijn-Newman流是U_ξ的单参数变形；(5) 基于von Mangoldt表示的Post-Widder+GBC方法无需RH和复数运算即可恢复π(x)。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 建立了ζ函数的两个互补Thorin表示，统一了完全单调函数框架；(2) 将RH等价转化为测度非负性这一简洁条件；(3) 揭示了零点简单性、函数方程、de Bruijn-Newman流在Thorin框架下的结构意义（纯指数卷积、Wald耦合对称性、单参数测度变形）。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 定量刻画了从零点恢复Thorin测度的指数病态性（条件数κ∼e^{cN}），为计算可行性提供了严格边界；(2) 提出了基于Post-Widder反演和生成式贝叶斯计算的素数计数新方法，完全不依赖RH和复数运算，具有实际计算价值。

title: Land, Power and Population Density in the Global Population Shifts of 1500 -1960
affiliations: ,  and Brown University

detail.title: Land, Power and Population Density in the Global Population Shifts of 1500 -1960
detail.abstract: The regional distribution of world population underwent profound changes during the age of exploration and colonization, in which a handful of European powers colonized the better part of the remaining continents. One consequence is that countries in the Americas, Australia and New Zealand, after sharp contractions of indigenous populations following exposure to Old World diseases, today have populations in which European or African descendants form majorities and speak predominantly European languages. Migration and in some cases colonization also altered population compositions in countries including South Africa, Cape Verde, Fiji and Singapore. And descendants of émigrés came to outnumber those of "stayers" in some non-colonizing countries, including Ireland and Lebanon. We identify major determinants of who settled where, during this era of colonialism and migration, demonstrating that both "natural" factors like availability and fertility of agricultural land and climate and disease prevalence, on the one hand, and power inequalities and cultural variables, on the other, explain the broad patterns of migration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了殖民与移民时代世界人口分布的深刻变化，分析了欧洲殖民扩张如何改变了美洲、澳洲、新西兰及其他地区的人口构成，并探讨了决定移民去向的主要因素，包括自然条件（土地、气候、疾病）与权力不平等、文化变量等。
AI.research_question: 在殖民与移民时代，哪些因素决定了不同人群的定居去向？自然条件与权力/文化因素各自发挥了怎样的作用？
AI.motivation: 殖民和移民时代深刻重塑了全球人口分布，但系统性地解释"谁去了哪里、为什么"的研究仍不充分。本文旨在填补这一空白，识别并量化决定移民模式的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合了地理决定论（自然条件如土地肥力、气候、疾病）与政治经济学/制度理论（权力不平等、殖民统治、文化因素），从自然与社会两个维度解释人口迁移模式。
AI.method: 基于历史数据，对殖民时期和移民时期的人口迁移模式进行实证分析，识别并比较自然因素（农业用地可及性、土地肥力、气候、疾病流行率）与权力/文化因素（殖民势力不平等、语言文化变量）的解释力。
AI.findings: 1）自然条件（农业土地可及性与肥力、气候适宜性、疾病负担）显著影响了殖民者的定居选择；2）权力不平等和文化变量同样对迁移模式具有重要解释力；3）两种因素的交互作用共同塑造了当今世界的人口分布格局。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地理决定论与政治经济学视角相结合，提出了一个综合分析自然条件与权力/文化因素如何共同塑造历史人口迁移模式的理论框架，丰富了关于殖民主义、人口变迁和长期经济发展根源的学术讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解当今世界各国人口构成（种族、语言）的历史根源，为移民政策、后殖民时期的社会融合以及全球人口发展提供历史经验参考。

title: An Adaptive Piano-Inspired Memristive Fractional-Order Cryptosystem for Secure Image Protection

detail.title: An Adaptive Piano-Inspired Memristive Fractional-Order Cryptosystem for Secure Image Protection
detail.abstract: The growing need for secure image transmission across public networks requires robust encryption algorithms. Traditional chaos-based image ciphers typically have a small key space, weak avalanche behavior, or are susceptible to differential cryptanalysis. To overcome such inadequacies, this paper suggests a new adaptive image cryptosystem that combines a fractional-order memristive chaotic engine and a non-linear hybrid encryption kernel. The system uses piano-inspired feedback; the keystream generator dynamically adapts to the previously encrypted pixel, enabling powerful Cipher Block Chaining (CBC)- style chaining and content-dependent diffusion. A four-dimensional memristive system is solved by the use of fractional-order calculus, which gives an ultra-large key space (>1080) and very high sensitivity to initial conditions—confirmed by a positive largest Lyapunov exponent (1.7199). The encryption kernel maps the traditional Exclusive OR (XOR) with the reversible two-step operation: the modular addition of the plaintext with the first keystream byte and the XOR with the second keystream one, both of which increase non-linearity and confusion. Large-scale experiments with six standard 256 × 256 colour images indicate almost ideal entropy (7.9994), Number of Pixel Change Rate (NPCR) which is 99.62, Unified Average Changing Intensity (UACI) which is 33.43, correlation coefficients are near to zero, very low Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) homogeneity (≈0.017) and high contrast (≈4843) and low energy (≈0.006 The ciphertext passes seven National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) SP-800-22 statistical tests, is extremely sensitive to keys (a perturbation of 1 × 10−14 alters >99.6% of ciphertext) and resists chosen-plaintext and known-plaintext attacks. Decryption has linear time complexity O(N), and average encryption and decryption times are 3.40 s and 2.75 s for 256 × 256 images. The proposed cryptosystem provides an attractive security–performance trade-off that can be used in high-security systems like medical image protection, privacy-preserving multimedia transmission, and secure cloud storage. Mathematics 2026, 14, 2125 https://doi

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合分数阶忆阻混沌引擎和非线性混合加密核的自适应图像加密系统，通过钢琴启发式反馈实现CBC风格的链式扩散，具有超大密钥空间（>10^80）和极高的密钥敏感性，在安全性（熵7.9994、NPCR 99.62、UACI 33.43）和性能（加密3.40秒、解密2.75秒）之间取得了良好平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种既能克服传统混沌图像加密算法密钥空间小、雪崩效应弱、易受差分密码分析等缺陷，又能兼顾安全性与性能的自适应图像加密系统？
AI.motivation: 传统基于混沌的图像加密算法存在密钥空间小、雪崩行为弱、易受差分密码分析等问题，难以满足日益增长的公共网络安全图像传输需求，亟需提出一种更安全高效的图像加密方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数阶忆阻混沌系统（四维忆阻系统，分数阶微积分求解）、Cipher Block Chaining（CBC）链式加密模式、非线性混合加密核（模加法与XOR组合操作）、钢琴启发式反馈自适应密钥流生成机制。
AI.method: 提出自适应图像密码系统：1）分数阶忆阻混沌引擎提供超大密钥空间（>10^80）和高初始条件敏感性（最大李雅普诺夫指数1.7199）；2）钢琴启发式反馈使密钥流生成器动态适应前一个加密像素，实现内容相关扩散；3）非线性加密核将传统XOR替换为可逆两步操作（模加法+XOR），增强非线性和混淆。使用六幅标准256×256彩色图像进行大规模实验验证。
AI.findings: 1）信息熵接近理想值7.9994；2）NPCR为99.62，UACI为33.43；3）相关系数接近零；4）GLCM同质性≈0.017，对比度≈4843，能量≈0.006；5）通过7项NIST SP-800-22统计测试；6）密钥极其敏感（10^-14的扰动改变>99.6%密文）；7）抗选择明文和已知明文攻击；8）加密3.40秒，解密2.75秒，时间复杂度O(N)。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将分数阶忆阻混沌系统引入图像加密，证明了其在提供超大密钥空间和超高敏感性方面的优势；2）提出钢琴启发式反馈机制，实现了内容依赖的自适应扩散，丰富了混沌加密的理论框架；3）设计可逆的非线性混合加密核（模加法+XOR），为传统XOR操作提供了增强非线性的替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了安全性与性能之间的可接受权衡方案，适用于医疗图像保护、隐私保护多媒体传输和云存储等安全要求高的场景；2）线性时间复杂度O(N)确保实际应用的效率可行性；3）全面的安全性评估（熵、NPCR、UACI、NIST测试、密钥敏感性、抗攻击能力）为实际部署提供了可靠的安全保障。

title: Reference-Translation and the Weighted Dutta-Ray Algorithm for Claims Problems
affiliations: Universitat de Barcelona, Universitat Abat Oliva CEU and University of Barcelona

detail.title: Reference-Translation and the Weighted Dutta-Ray Algorithm for Claims Problems

declarations.funderStatement: The authors gratefully acknowledge financial support from the Spanish Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades through Grant PID2023-150472NB-I00/AEI/10.13039/501100011033, and from the Generalitat de Catalunya through Grant 2021-SGR-00306

detail.abstract:
The Dutta-Ray egalitarian solution for a convex transferable utility game (Dutta and Ray, 1989) selects the Lorenz-maximal allocation in the core and can be computed through a recursive average-worth algorithm. In this paper, we combine two elementary extensions of this procedure. The first extension translates a convex game by means of a modular game generated by a reference vector, applies the Dutta-Ray algorithm to the translated game, and then restores efficiency by adding back the reference vector. For the second extension, we adopt the weighted version of the Dutta-Ray algorithm for convex games introduced by Koster (1999, 2002). This weighted procedure is well defined for convex games and returns a core allocation. 
When applied to claims problems, these constructions provide a common cooperativegame-theoretic foundation for the broad family of egalitarian-in-deviation rules (Izquierdo and Rafels, 2026). In particular, the constrained equal awards rule (CEA), the constrained equal losses rule (CEL), the family of reverse Talmud rules, the weighted CEA and weighted CEL rules, and the proportional rule are all based on Dutta-Ray solutions and obtained by choosing suitable reference vectors and/or weights.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将凸博弈的Dutta-Ray算法进行模块平移和加权扩展，为索赔问题中的一系列公平分配规则提供了统一的合作博弈理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何通过扩展Dutta-Ray均衡解，为索赔问题中的多种分配规则提供统一的合作博弈理论基础？
AI.motivation: 现有的Dutta-Ray均衡解仅适用于凸博弈的标准情形，而索赔问题中出现了多种分配规则（如等额约束奖励规则、等额约束损失规则等），需要从一个统一的理论框架来解释和推导这些规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: Dutta-Ray均衡解、凸博弈核心分配、Lorenz最优分配、模块博弈平移、加权Dutta-Ray算法、等偏离规则家族。
AI.method: 理论推导与构造性方法。首先对凸博弈进行模块平移，应用Dutta-Ray算法后还原效率；其次引入Koster（1999, 2002）的加权版本。将这两种扩展应用于索赔问题。
AI.findings: 索赔问题中的等额约束奖励规则（CEA）、等额约束损失规则（CEL）、反Talmud规则族、加权CEA和加权CEL规则、以及比例规则，均可通过选择适当的参考向量和/或权重，由Dutta-Ray解构造得到。
AI.theory_contributions: 为等偏离规则（egalitarian-in-deviation rules）这一广泛的分配规则家族提供了统一的合作博弈理论基础，揭示了这些规则在本质上都是Dutta-Ray解的变体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为索赔问题中的多种分配规则提供了理论正当性，有助于理解和比较不同分配规则的内在逻辑，为实际分配机制设计提供指导。

title: Clearing Conditional Commitments: Privacy, Specification, and Custody in a Clearinghouse for Interdependent Action
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Clearing Conditional Commitments: Privacy, Specification, and Custody in a Clearinghouse for Interdependent Action

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Generative AI was used to assist in drafting and typesetting this manuscript from the author's research notes and proposition drafts, in formalizing and cross-checking the proofs, and in adversarial verification of the results. The author developed the model, results, and arguments, reviewed the entire manuscript, and is responsible for all content, including every mathematical claim.

detail.abstract: Latent willingness of the form "I will, if enough of the right others will" has no standard clearing institution. We model a conditional-commitment clearinghouse: a platform that authenticates participants (accuracy q), verifies that their mutual conditions are jointly satisfiable (consensus integrity c), routes compatible counterparts to one another, and chooses three design dials-custody of principal γ, specification timing σ, and disclosure granularity k-before activating the coalition at a fixed point. Our central result is that the welfare-maximizing clearinghouse is minimal on all three dials at once: it holds no principal, fixes terms late, and discloses progress only through a k-anonymized aggregate. The result is stated with its boundary: it holds in a bounded high-authenticity, intermediate-integrity region, reverses on each axis outside it, and the three minimalisms are coupled in welfare magnitude rather than additively separable. Three further results discipline the disclosure claim. First, the privacy dial's screening cost is a genuine information-leakage object-the Shannon mutual information between coalition type and the k-anonymized support count-and full disclosure does not perfectly screen. Second, the masking advantage survives a refinement-free selection: under Carlsson-van Damme risk dominance no rationality parameter appears anywhere in the model, the revealed game's contested-regime collapse is exact, and masked momentum is sustained-proven at the deadline rung and for the smallest coalitions, conjecture-gated (and grid-verified) at interior rungs. Third, partial masking is constrained-optimal for a structural reason: a single disclosure dial necessarily bundles "this coalition is real" with "you are not pivotal," so-in a one-round theorem extended by a dynamic calibration-the interior optimum exists even where the unconstrained ideal would be full type-disclosure with zero pivotality leakage. We state three formal propositions with complete proofs, enumerate the open conjectures, and propose an administrable safe-harbor rule keyed to the mechanism's structure.

AI.tldr: 本文建模了一个条件承诺清算所平台，证明福利最大化设计是同时在三个维度上最小化：不托管本金、晚期确认条款、仅通过k匿名聚合披露进度。这一结果在特定边界内成立，边界外会反转，且三个最小化策略在福利效应上耦合而非可加。进一步分析了隐私披露的筛选成本、掩蔽优势的稳健性，以及部分掩蔽的结构性最优性。
AI.research_question: 条件承诺清算所的最优设计是什么？即在参与者有条件承诺（"如果足够多的合适他人愿意，我就愿意"）的情境下，平台应如何选择托管本金、条款确认时机和披露粒度这三个设计变量以最大化福利？
AI.motivation: 现实中有大量"有条件承诺"的集体行动（如气候协定、集体诉讼、众筹等），但缺乏标准化的清算机构来协调这种条件性意愿，导致合作难以达成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、机制设计、信息经济学；Carlsson-van Damme风险占优；Shannon互信息；k-匿名隐私保护理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与数学证明，包含三个正式命题及完整证明、动态校准扩展、网格数值验证。
AI.findings: （1）福利最大化清算所在三个设计维度上均取最小值：零托管、晚期条款确认、k匿名聚合披露；（2）该结果成立的条件是"高真实性、中等共识完整性"区域，边界外各轴反转；（3）三个最小化策略在福利量级上耦合而非可加；（4）完全披露并不能完美筛选；（5）部分掩蔽优于完全披露，且该优势在风险占优选择下依然成立；（6）部分掩蔽是约束最优的，因为单一披露旋钮必然同时传递"联盟真实"和"你非关键"两个信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模条件承诺清算所的最优设计，揭示了信息隐私与协调效率之间的结构性权衡；证明了隐私披露的筛选成本本质是信息泄露的Shannon互信息量；提出了部分掩蔽的结构性最优定理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计集体行动平台（如气候联盟、集体诉讼、众筹等）提供了具体的设计原则：零托管、晚期确认、k匿名披露；提出了可管理的安全港规则以指导实际运作。

title: Beyond AI Detection: The Productive AI Integration Framework (PAIF) for Teaching, Assessment, and Student Engagement in Higher Education

detail.title: Beyond AI Detection: The Productive AI Integration Framework (PAIF) for Teaching, Assessment, and Student Engagement in Higher Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests, personal relationships, or conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) is rapidly transforming teaching, assessment, and student engagement in higher education. While existing discussions frequently focus on academic integrity, AI detection, institutional policies, and ethical concerns, comparatively less attention has been devoted to how AI can be integrated productively to support meaningful learning. This paper proposes the Productive AI Integration Framework (PAIF), a conceptual framework designed to guide the responsible integration of Generative AI within higher education. Adopting a Design Science perspective, the framework was developed in response to three interconnected educational challenges: cognitive dependency in AI-assisted learning, the assessment of authentic competence in environments where AI can generate sophisticated outputs, and passive student engagement with AI-generated content. PAIF integrates three complementary components. The Cognitive Offloading Framework distinguishes cognitive activities that should remain the responsibility of learners from those that may be productively supported by AI systems. The PAO Model (Process, Artifact, and Oral) provides a multidimensional approach for evaluating authentic competence beyond final outputs. The AI Engagement Spectrum conceptualizes student interaction with AI as a progression from passive answer consumption toward reflective inquiry and self-regulated learning. Drawing upon constructivism, cognitive offloading theory, authentic assessment, self-regulated learning, and metacognition, the framework offers a unified pedagogical perspective on productive AI integration. The paper contributes an integrated approach that shifts the focus from AI restriction and detection toward the design of learning environments that preserve reasoning, authentic competence, and meaningful engagement while leveraging the benefits of AI-assisted learning. The framework provides a foundation for future empirical research and practical implementation across diverse higher education contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了生产性AI整合框架(PAIF)，旨在指导高等教育中负责任地整合生成式AI，通过认知卸载框架、PAO模型和AI参与光谱三个互补组件，解决AI辅助学习中的认知依赖、真实能力评估和学生被动参与三大挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何在高等教育中负责任且富有成效地整合生成式AI，以促进有意义的学习？
AI.motivation: 现有讨论多聚焦于学术诚信、AI检测、机构政策和伦理问题，较少关注如何将AI有效整合以支持有意义的学习。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建构主义、认知卸载理论、真实评估、自我调节学习、元认知
AI.method: 设计科学视角（Design Science），概念框架开发
AI.findings: 提出了包含三个互补组件的PAIF框架：认知卸载框架（区分学习者应保留的认知活动与可借助AI的活动）、PAO模型（过程-作品-口试三维评估真实能力）、AI参与光谱（从被动接收答案到反思性探究和自我调节学习的进阶）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的教学视角，将关注点从AI限制和检测转向设计能够保持推理、真实能力和有意义参与的学习环境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育中生成式AI的负责任整合提供了具体框架和指导原则，为未来实证研究和跨情境实践奠定了基础。

title: The Health System’s Collaboration with Other Sectors in Response to Cyclone Freddy in Blantyre and Phalombe Districts of Malawi: A Case Study of Cyclone Freddy 2023
affiliations: University of the Western Cape and University of the Western Cape

detail.title: The Health System’s Collaboration with Other Sectors in Response to Cyclone Freddy in Blantyre and Phalombe Districts of Malawi: A Case Study of Cyclone Freddy 2023
detail.abstract: Introduction: The occurrence of climate change-induced extreme weather events requires multisector collaboration for effective response. This study explores the health system collaboration with other sectors in Blantyre and Phalombe districts of Malawi during the Cyclone Freddy response. The aim was to gain an in-depth understanding of the strategies used, the coordination mechanisms, and the identified gaps to be addressed for effective future collaboration.Methods: Key informant interviews and focus group discussions were conducted with Directors and other senior officials from all sectors at district council level. The study was grounded in a framework for multisector and multilevel collaboration, drawing on data from key informant interviews and focus group discussions.Results: In total, eleven key informant interviews and four focus group discussions were conducted. The findings indicate partial collaboration across sectors, as some criteria were not fully considered or followed. These include the preconditions, key drivers, mechanisms, structures, administration, execution, and evaluation for effective multisector collaboration. In addition, the lack of interdependency, standard operating procedures, guidelines, and capacity building limited effective collaboration among sectors.Conclusion: There is partial collaboration among sectors at the district council level under decentralization. The study findings provide evidence that could support the establishment of viable multisector collaboration under decentralization in Malawi.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨马拉维两地区在应对气旋Freddy事件中卫生系统与其他部门的跨部门协作情况，发现存在部分协作，但缺乏相互依存性、标准操作程序、指南和能力建设等问题限制了有效协作。
AI.research_question: 在马拉维Blantyre和Phalombe地区应对气旋Freddy事件中，卫生系统如何与其他部门进行协作？存在哪些策略、协调机制及需要改进的差距？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致的极端天气事件频发，需要多部门协作才能有效应对，因此需要深入了解现有协作模式及不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门与多层次协作框架
AI.method: 定性研究方法：关键知情人访谈（11次）和焦点小组讨论（4次），对象为地区理事会级别的各部门主任及高级官员。
AI.findings: 存在部分协作，但未能充分满足有效跨部门协作的先决条件、关键驱动因素、机制、结构、行政管理、执行和评估等标准。缺乏相互依存性、标准操作程序、指南和能力建设是主要限制因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于分权治理背景下跨部门协作的理论理解，识别了部分协作的具体维度及影响因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为马拉维分权体制下建立可行的多部门协作提供了实证依据，有助于改进未来极端天气事件的应急管理实践。

title: The One-Stop-Shop Is One Step in the Right Direction
affiliations: Fordham University School of Law

detail.title: The One-Stop-Shop Is One Step in the Right Direction
detail.abstract: In Brokering Safety, Sharma, Kadri, and Adler urge federal policymakers to impose on data brokers the greater duty of policing and stemming online stalking, harassment, and related abuse; that burden should not fall to victims, they argue. Their proposal would close the unevenness among state laws, shift the burden of oversight away from victims, and, importantly, ensure accountability at a systemic level, addressing gaps in enforcement that allow brokers to evade meaningful consequences. Yet, the one-stop-shop solution that Brokering Safety proposes also accedes to the core neoliberal presumption insofar as it individualizes harm. Online abuse, like dark patterns and surveillance pricing, is just one of the many inevitable consequences of the laissez-faire regulatory approach to commercial surveillance in the United States. Given the authors’ stated concern about information asymmetries, we might assume that they would turn to structural fixes like broad purpose limitations or data minimization rules that reduce the pecuniary incentive to traffic in personal data. Such measures have the added advantage of mostly avoiding the First Amendment hurdle to the extent they are neither content-based nor have incidental effects on the lawful distribution of truthful information. In the end, this short response essay argues that Sharma, Kadri, and Adler are right to attend to data broker harms, but their recommendations for reform are incomplete given the information asymmetries that motivate their intervention in the first place.

AI.tldr: 本文回应Sharma、Kadri和Adler的《Brokering Safety》一文，肯定其关注数据经纪人危害的正确性，但指出其提出的"一站式"解决方案存在局限性：它接受了新自由主义的核心假设——将伤害个体化，而未能触及商业监控的深层结构问题。作者建议采用更根本的结构性修复措施，如广泛目的限制和数据最小化规则。
AI.research_question: 如何更有效地规制数据经纪人造成的在线骚扰、跟踪及相关滥用问题？现有"一站式"解决方案存在哪些不足？
AI.motivation: 作者认为Sharma等人的提案虽然正确关注了数据经纪人的危害，但其方案局限于个体化伤害的矫正，未能解决美国商业监控自由放任监管模式下更深层次的结构性问题（如信息不对称）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新自由主义批判、信息不对称理论、结构性修复与个体化救济的对比分析
AI.method: 批判性回应论文，通过逻辑论证和理论分析对原提案进行审视
AI.findings: 1. Sharma等人的提案虽然有效（弥合州法差异、转移监督负担、确保系统性问责），但接受了新自由主义预设——将伤害个体化。2. 在线滥用（如暗黑模式、监控定价）是美国对商业监控采取自由放任监管的必然结果。3. 更好的方案是采用结构性措施，如广泛目的限制和数据最小化规则，这些措施还能规避第一修正案障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数据经纪人规制中个体化救济路径与结构性修复路径之间的张力，指出单纯转移受害者负担而不改变商业监控激励结构的不完整性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更根本的监管思路：不应仅关注"谁来监督"，而应关注"为何会有如此多数据被收集和交易"，建议采用目的限制和数据最小化等结构性规则。

title: Adjudicating and Subjectivizing: The Role of Supranational Body in Governments’ Fiscal Transparency
affiliations: and Australian National University (ANU)

detail.title: Adjudicating and Subjectivizing: The Role of Supranational Body in Governments’ Fiscal Transparency
detail.abstract: Faced with fiscal constraints, many governments provide guarantees in public-private partnerships to incentivise private capital to complement public investment. While such guarantees enhance the creditworthiness of PPP projects, they also expose governments to significant fiscal risks if not properly accounted for and managed, raising concerns about fiscal transparency and accountability. This paper examines how accounting effects fiscal reform through its adjudicating and subjectivizing roles. Focusing on the International Monetary Fund’s efforts to promote fiscal transparency in Brazil, we analyse changes in government reporting of PPP guarantees and contingent liabilities following IMF monitoring. This study contributes to a better understanding of accounting’s roles in governance by demonstrating how supranational adjudication can drive national accounting change without coercive power, and how institutional logics shape a government’s subjectivizing behaviours. The findings have implications for international organisations seeking to foster fiscal transparency and for governments navigating external demands alongside domestic institutional logics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在国际货币基金组织监管下，巴西政府如何通过会计的裁决和主体化作用推动财政改革，具体体现在PPP政府担保和或有负债的报告变化上，揭示了超国家裁决如何在不使用强制权力的情况下推动国家会计变革。
AI.research_question: 会计如何通过其裁决作用和主体化作用影响财政改革？
AI.motivation: 政府为PPP项目提供担保虽能吸引私人资本，但若不加以适当核算和管理，会带来重大财政风险，引发财政透明度和问责制担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 会计的裁决作用（adjudicating）和主体化作用（subjectivizing）；制度逻辑（institutional logics）
AI.method: 案例研究，聚焦国际货币基金组织（IMF）推动巴西财政透明的努力，分析IMF监管前后巴西政府PPP担保和或有负债报告的变化。
AI.findings: 超国家裁决可以在没有强制权力的情况下推动国家会计变革；制度逻辑塑造政府的主体化行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对会计在治理中角色的理解，揭示了超国家机构如何通过裁决作用驱动国家层面的会计变革，以及制度逻辑如何影响政府的主体化行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 对寻求促进财政透明的国际组织具有启示意义，并为政府在应对外部需求与国内制度逻辑之间寻求平衡提供参考。

title: Impact of Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Developments on the Implied Equity Risk Premium of Nifty 50
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Impact of Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Developments on the Implied Equity Risk Premium of Nifty 50
detail.abstract:
The Implied Equity Risk Premium (ERP) is a forward-looking measure of the additional return investors demand for investing in equities over risk-free securities. As it is derived from current market prices and expected future cash flows, it serves as an important indicator of investor sentiment and market risk perception. 

This study examines the impact of macroeconomic and geopolitical developments on the Implied ERP of the Nifty 50 Index during the period from 1 January 2026 to 15 June 2026. Using an aggregate valuation approach, the Nifty 50 is treated as a single economic entity, and the implied cost of equity is estimated through a discounted cash flow framework based on projected Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE). The Implied ERP is then determined by subtracting the risk-free rate from the estimated cost of equity. 

The analysis indicates that the Implied ERP remained relatively stable during the study period, averaging approximately 5.3%, while exhibiting fluctuations in response to significant economic, regulatory, and geopolitical events. Key developments such as the Union Budget 2026, regulatory announcements, and escalating tensions in the Middle East influenced investor expectations and market valuations. Sectoral analysis further highlights the significant role of Financial Services, Oil & Gas, and Information Technology sectors in shaping market risk perceptions. 

The findings demonstrate that the Implied ERP is an effective real-time measure of investor sentiment and provides valuable insights into the relationship between market valuation, risk perception, and external economic developments in the Indian equity market

AI.tldr: 本研究通过隐含股权风险溢价（Implied ERP）分析印度Nifty 50指数在2026年1月1日至6月15日期间宏观经济与地缘政治事件对投资者情绪的影响，发现平均ERP约为5.3%，且金融、油气和信息技术板块对市场风险感知贡献显著。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济与地缘政治事件如何影响印度Nifty 50指数的隐含股权风险溢价（Implied ERP）？
AI.motivation: 隐含ERP是前瞻性的投资者情绪和市场风险感知指标，但现有研究对新兴市场（尤其是印度）在重大宏观与地缘事件下的动态变化关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐含股权风险溢价理论、折现现金流模型（FCFE估值框架）、市场风险感知与投资者情绪理论。
AI.method: 采用聚合估值法，将Nifty 50视为单一经济实体，通过基于预期自由现金流（FCFE）的折现现金流模型估算隐含权益成本，再减去无风险利率得到隐含ERP。时间跨度为2026年1月1日至6月15日。
AI.findings: （1）隐含ERP在研究期内平均约5.3%，总体保持稳定；（2）印度联邦预算2026、监管公告和中东局势升级等事件引发ERP波动；（3）金融服务、油气、信息技术三大板块对市场风险感知的塑造作用显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了隐含ERP作为新兴市场（印度）实时投资者情绪指标的有效性，拓展了ERP理论在宏观-地缘政治事件背景下的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供了识别印度权益市场风险感知变化的实时工具，有助于政策制定者和投资者根据板块层面的风险信号做出更精准的决策。

title: The Geometry of Flat Payoffs in First-price Auctions

detail.title: The Geometry of Flat Payoffs in First-price Auctions

keywords: Flat Payoff Property JEL Classification: C72

detail.abstract: Why do bidders in first-price auctions systematically deviate from Nash equilibrium bids, yet suffer negligible losses? This paper addresses this puzzle by providing a structural characterization of the Flat Payoff Property in symmetric environments. I define a Payoff Flatness Index, the reciprocal of the local curvature of the interim utility function, that fully characterizes a bidder's strategic insensitivity to bid deviations. I prove that while payoff landscapes eventually flatten for all interior types, this transition is non-monotonic. For high-valuation bidders, additional competition initially steepens the payoff landscape before the declining probability of winning asymptotically dominates. A closed-form decomposition of the curvature isolates three channels driving this result: probability decay, degrees of freedom, and shading compression. The findings establish that strategic insensitivity is a structural consequence of the first-price mechanism itself, not a behavioral anomaly requiring non-standard preference. The results reconcile decades of experimental findings with standard equilibrium theory.

AI.tldr: 本文从结构上解释了为什么一级价格拍卖中投标人系统性地偏离纳什均衡出价却损失甚微，发现这种策略不敏感性是一级价格机制自身的结构性特征，而非行为异常。
AI.research_question: 一级价格拍卖中投标人为何系统性地偏离纳什均衡出价，却几乎不遭受损失？
AI.motivation: 实验经济学长期发现投标人偏离纳什均衡但损失极小，这一"均衡-偏离"悖论缺乏结构性解释，现有文献多归于行为因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 支付平坦属性（Flat Payoff Property）；支付平坦度指数（Payoff Flatness Index）；中间效用函数的局部曲率；概率衰减、自由度、出价压缩三渠道分解。
AI.method: 对称环境下的结构性特征刻画；闭式分解推导；非单调性分析。
AI.findings: 所有内部类型的支付景观最终都会变平坦，但这一转变是非单调的；高估值投标人在竞争增加时支付景观先变陡后变平；概率衰减、自由度和出价压缩是三个驱动渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了策略不敏感性是一级价格拍卖机制的结构性特征，而非行为异常；为数十年的实验发现与标准均衡理论之间提供了理论调和。
AI.practical_contributions: 对拍卖机制设计、投标策略优化以及实验经济学中"偏离-损失"悖论的理解具有指导意义。

title: A Unified Real-Time AI Framework for Dual-Organ Ultrasound Interpretation: A Multi-Center, Multi-Reader Study
affiliations: Capital Medical University, Capital Medical University, Capital Medical University and

detail.title: A Unified Real-Time AI Framework for Dual-Organ Ultrasound Interpretation: A Multi-Center, Multi-Reader Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.

detail.abstract:
Background: Breast and thyroid nodules are among the most common lesions encountered in ultrasound practice and account for a substantial diagnostic workload worldwide. Current artificial intelligence (AI) systems are largely restricted to single-organ assessment using static images and have shown limited integration into routine clinical workflows. We developed and validated NoduleNet, a unified AI framework for real-time detection, binary risk classification, and guideline-based risk stratification of breast and thyroid nodules from ultrasound video streams.

Methods: In this multi-center diagnostic study, 15,332 ultrasound videos (9,596 breast and 5,736 thyroid examinations) from four hospitals were retrospectively collected for model development and external validation. NoduleNet incorporated spatiotemporal feature extraction and cross-organ transfer learning to enable unified analysis of breast and thyroid nodules. Model performance was evaluated for lesion detection, binary risk classification, and guideline-based risk stratification according to ACR BI-RADS and C TI-RADS. Clinical utility was prospectively assessed in a fully crossed multi-reader, multi-case study involving 281 ultrasound videos and nine radiologists with varying levels of experience.

Findings: On the independent test set, NoduleNet achieved F1 scores of 0·851 for breast nodule detection and 0·880 for thyroid nodule detection. For binary risk classification, the model achieved an AUC of 0·895 (95% CI: 0·855-0·934) for breast nodules and 0·816 (95% CI: 0·784-0·849) for thyroid nodules. Corresponding AUCs for BI-RADS and TI-RADS risk stratification were 0·782 (95% CI: 0·716-0·841) and 0·704 (95% CI: 0·655-0·751), respectively. In the prospective reader study, AI assistance significantly improved lesion detection, diagnostic consistency, and workflow efficiency across all experience levels, with the greatest benefits observed among junior radiologists. AI-assisted junior radiologists achieved diagnostic performance approaching that of unassisted senior radiologists while reducing interpretation time by more than 40%.

Interpretation: NoduleNet enables accurate real-time ultrasound interpretation of breast and thyroid nodules within a single unified framework. By combining dual-organ analysis, video-based assessment, and prospective clinical validation, the system improves diagnostic performance, reduces inter-observer variability, and enhances workflow efficiency. These findings support the integration of AI-assisted ultrasound interpretation into routine nodule screening and risk assessment pathways.

AI.tldr: NoduleNet是一个统一的AI框架，能够从超声视频流中实时检测、二元风险分类并基于指南对乳腺和甲状腺结节进行风险分层。在多中心研究中，该框架在结节检测、风险分类和分层方面表现良好，前瞻性研究表明AI辅助显著提升了诊断性能、一致性和工作效率，尤其对初级放射科医生帮助最大。
AI.research_question: 如何开发并验证一个统一的AI框架（NoduleNet），用于从超声视频流中实时检测、二元风险分类和基于指南的风险分层乳腺和甲状腺结节？
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统多局限于单器官、静态图像的评估，且难以融入常规临床工作流程。乳腺和甲状腺结节是超声实践中常见的病变，诊断工作量巨大，亟需一个统一的、基于视频流的AI系统来提升诊断效率和准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时空特征提取（spatiotemporal feature extraction）、跨器官迁移学习（cross-organ transfer learning）、ACR BI-RADS和C TI-RADS风险分层指南。
AI.method: 多中心诊断研究。回顾性收集4家医院的15,332个超声视频（9,596个乳腺、5,736个甲状腺）用于模型开发和外部验证。前瞻性采用完全交叉的多读者多病例研究设计，包含281个超声视频和9名不同经验水平的放射科医生。
AI.findings: 独立测试集上，乳腺和甲状腺结节检测F1分数分别为0.851和0.880；二元风险分类AUC分别为0.895和0.816；BI-RADS和TI-RADS风险分层AUC分别为0.782和0.704。前瞻性研究中，AI辅助显著改善了所有经验水平医生的病变检测、诊断一致性和工作效率，初级放射科医生获益最大，其诊断性能接近未辅助的高级医生，且解读时间减少40%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的、基于超声视频流的双器官AI诊断框架，整合了时空特征提取和跨器官迁移学习，突破了现有AI系统单器官、静态图像的限制。
AI.practical_contributions: NoduleNet可在实际临床中实现乳腺和甲状腺结节的实时AI辅助超声解读，显著提升诊断性能、减少观察者间变异、提高工作效率，尤其有助于初级医生快速提升诊断水平，支持将AI辅助超声解读纳入常规结节筛查和风险评估流程。

title: Do AIs Make Good Traders, and Do They Make Good Traders Better?
affiliations: , Elm Partners and Elm Partners

detail.title: Do AIs Make Good Traders, and Do They Make Good Traders Better?
detail.abstract:
Recent advances in large language models have renewed interest in the idea that artificial intelligence can predict market movements from news and other public information. This article examines that premise through a practical lens, exploring whether modern AI systems can consistently generate trading profits in highly competitive financial markets. Drawing on evidence from market efficiency, behavioral finance, and empirical testing, the discussion highlights the distinction between information processing and investment success. While AI excels at rapidly synthesizing vast amounts of data, markets quickly incorporate widely available information, limiting the persistence of purely predictive advantages.

The article argues that the greatest value of AI in investing may lie not in forecasting returns, but in improving decision-making processes, enforcing discipline, reducing behavioral biases, and enhancing portfolio construction and risk management. It further emphasizes the challenges posed by transaction costs, crowding effects, model overfitting, and the adaptive nature of financial markets, all of which can erode apparent predictive edges. The conclusion suggests that AI is likely to become an increasingly important tool for investors, but one that complements rather than replaces sound investment principles. Long-term investment outcomes may depend less on finding a perfect forecasting model and more on using AI to support robust, systematic, and evidence-based decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大型语言模型等AI在金融市场中预测走势的能力，认为虽然AI在信息处理上有优势，但由于市场有效性和竞争，预测优势难以持久。AI最大的价值不在于预测回报，而在于改善投资决策过程、减少行为偏差、加强风险管理，并作为传统投资原则的补充工具。
AI.research_question: 现代AI系统能否在高度竞争的金融市场中持续产生交易利润？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的最新进展重新引发了人们对于AI能否从新闻等公开信息中预测市场走势的兴趣，本文旨在通过实践视角审视这一预设立场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、行为金融学、实证检验
AI.method: 基于市场效率、行为金融学和实证检验证据的综合讨论与分析
AI.findings: AI在快速合成大量数据方面表现出色，但市场会迅速吸收广泛可获取的信息，限制了纯粹预测优势的持续性；AI在投资中最大的价值在于改善决策过程、强化纪律、减少行为偏差、优化投资组合构建和风险管理；交易成本、拥挤效应、模型过拟合和市场的适应性会侵蚀表面的预测优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了信息处理能力与投资成功之间的鸿沟，指出AI的预测优势在有效市场中难以持续，挑战了AI能直接预测市场走势的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了AI应用的务实定位：AI应作为补充而非替代传统投资原则的工具，长期投资成果更依赖于利用AI支持稳健、系统化、基于证据的决策，而非寻找完美的预测模型。

title: Preeclampsia Prevention by Risk-Stratified Timed Birth: A Bayesian Analysis
affiliations: University of Exeter, King’s College London, NHS Foundation Trust - Fetal Medicine Research Institute, King’s College London - Department of Women and Children’s Health, King’s College London - Department of Women and Children’s Health, University of Exeter - Institute of Health Research and NHS Foundation Trust - Fetal Medicine Research Institute

detail.title: Preeclampsia Prevention by Risk-Stratified Timed Birth: A Bayesian Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was granted by the NHS Research Ethics Committee (NHS Health Research Authority London–Surrey Research Ethics Committee (22/LO/0794)), and all participants provided written informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Fetal Medicine Foundation (UK Charity No: 1037116). Reagents and equipment for the measurement of serum placental growth factor and soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase receptor 1 were provided free of charge by Thermo Fisher Scientific.

detail.abstract:
Background: PREVENT-PE was a trial (n=8,094 women) comparing usual care with planned timed birth between 37 and 40 weeks’ gestation, based on risk stratification for preeclampsia (PE) at 35–36 weeks. In the intervention group, there was a 30% reduction in birth with PE, without an increase in emergency cesarean or neonatal unit (NNU) admission for ≥48 hours. 

Methods: This post hoc Bayesian analysis evaluates the impact of the intervention within each PE risk stratum in 4,734 participants from one study site where biobanked samples and hemodynamic assessments were available, permitting calculation of PE risk. Outcomes were birth with PE (primary trial outcome), and emergency cesarean and NNU for ≥48 hours (key secondary outcomes). 

Findings: Birth with PE incidence was 5.7% (95% credible interval [CrI], 4.7-6.8) in the control group and 4.1% [3.4-4.9] in the intervention group, for a posterior median incidence ratio of 0.72 [0.56-0.93] and a posterior probability-of-benefit of 0.995, consistent in direction and magnitude with those of the primary PREVENT-PE trial. However, overall benefit was driven primarily by the 39- and 40-week strata (posterior probabilities-of-benefit 0.985 and 0.992, respectively), with little evidence of excess NNU admission for ≥48 hours (posterior probability-of-harm 0.651 and 0.679, respectively), but a potential increase in emergency cesarean in the 39-week but not 40-week groups (posterior probability-of-harm 0.857 and 0.353). There was little evidence of benefit in 37- and 38-week strata (posterior probabilities-of-benefit, 0.463 and 0.622, respectively), and some evidence of excess NNU admission for ≥48 hours (posterior probabilities-of-harm, 0.746 and 0.825, respectively), but substantial uncertainty due to small numbers. 

Interpretation: Risk stratification with timed birth was associated with evidence of benefit in 39- and 40-week strata, with little suggestion of neonatal harm. In 37- and 38-week strata, there was no evidence of benefit, but potential neonatal harm consistent with early-term birth.

AI.tldr: 基于子痫前期风险分层（35-36周）的择期分娩（37-40周）干预，在39周和40周分娩组中显著降低子痫前期发生率且不增加新生儿不良结局，但在37周和38周分娩组中未见获益且可能有新生儿危害。
AI.research_question: 在不同子痫前期风险分层（37、38、39、40周）中，基于风险分层的择期分娩干预对子痫前期发生率、急诊剖宫产和新生儿住院≥48小时的影响是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: PREVENT-PE主试验已表明基于风险分层的择期分娩（37-40周）可降低子痫前期发生率30%且不增加急诊剖宫产或新生儿住院风险，但尚不清楚这一获益是否在各孕周风险分层中一致，以及是否存在特定孕周组的潜在危害。
AI.theoretical_framework: 子痫前期风险分层理论、择期分娩时机理论、早产与新生儿结局关系理论。
AI.method: 对PREVENT-PE试验中一个研究中心的4,734名参与者进行事后贝叶斯分析，按子痫前期风险分层（37、38、39、40周）评估干预效果，主要结局为伴有子痫前期的分娩，次要结局为急诊剖宫产和新生儿住院≥48小时。
AI.findings: 总体干预组子痫前期发生率（4.1%）低于对照组（5.7%），获益概率0.995；但获益主要由39周和40周分层驱动（获益概率分别为0.985和0.992），且这两个分层未见明显新生儿住院增加（危害概率0.651和0.679），39周急诊剖宫产可能增加（危害概率0.857）而40周未增加（0.353）；37周和38周分层未见明显获益（获益概率0.463和0.622），且有新生儿住院增加趋势（危害概率0.746和0.825），但因样本量小存在较大不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 细化了子痫前期风险分层择期分娩理论，揭示了不同孕周分层获益与风险的不对称性，为精准分娩时机决策提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 临床实践中，基于子痫前期风险分层择期分娩应优先考虑39周和40周分娩，避免在37周和38周进行干预，以平衡母体获益与新生儿风险。

title: Deep Learning for Pressure Injury Staging in Real-World Inpatient Photographs Evaluated across Diverse Skin Tones
